10.5 Organizzare il tempo di lavoro
Il tempo rappresenta una variabile di progettazione organizzativa relativamente nuova nella
letteratura manageriale, ma la crescente competizione e l’evoluzione tecnologica lo hanno
reso fondamentale. La strutturazione dei tempi e degli spazi di lavoro è stata influenzata da
modelli rigidi di origine fordista, ma questi risultano poco adatti alle diverse situazioni
individuali, alla dinamica della tecnologia e alle esigenze del business. L’integrazione tra gli
orari dell’azienda e quelli privati sta causando problemi di compatibilità e di conflitto, ma
anche opportunità.
In tema di orari prevale la sincronizzazione → l'addensamento spazio-temporale di attività
umane così che una grande quantità di persone fanno le stesse cose negli stessi luoghi,
negli stessi orari, usando le stesse infrastrutture logistiche o produttive.
Le spinte verso la sincronizzazione sono di tipo
● rituale (identità, senso di appartenenza, effetto comunità),
● economico (economie di scala e di prossimità),
● politico (controllo, visibilità, potere),
● organizzativo (standardizzazione, specializzazione degli addetti e delle strutture),
● culturale (valori),
● climatico (le stagioni),
● urbanistico (spazi e flussi)
L’estensione dei tempi di funzionamento degli impianti e delle infrastrutture oltre gli orari
standard è spinta da motivazioni economiche, tecniche e logistiche. Tuttavia, per far fronte a
questa flessibilità, è necessario ampliare gli spazi di compatibilità tra tempi privati e tempi di
lavoro. Le aziende richiedono lavoro in tempi e quantità non standard, mentre i lavoratori
offrono lavoro disallineato con gli orari standard.
La desincronizzazione può facilitare la convergenza tra queste esigenze e si realizza
nell'organizzazione della produzione e dei servizi attraverso la rimodulazione di orari e spazi
di lavoro.
Questo ha portato allo sviluppo del part time, dell'orario flessibile, di distribuzioni non
convenzionali di orario giornaliero o settimanale o mensile o di smart working.
Le possibilità di conciliazione aumentano in funzione
1. della dimensione d'impresa: le grandi dimensioni consentono di assorbire la variabilità
individuale distribuendo i costi su grandi volumi
2. della varietà di attività presenti: un'ampia varietà di funzioni e attività (produ- zione, servizi,
amministrazione, logistica e distribuzione, più siti operativi e cosi via) consente plù
facilmente di soddisfare esigenze individuali diverse
3. della varietà della popolazione aziendale: una composizione variegata della demografia
aziendale per genere, classi di età, situazione familiare, interessi extra lavorativi,
appartenenza a reti sociali aumenta le possibilità combinatorie,4. della possibilità di socializzare i costi della compatibilità per non penalizzare i soggetti che
più ne hanno bisogno: i sistemi di welfare sono il tipico strumento di socializzazione dei
costi.
5.del grado di dematerializzatone di prodotti servizi e di digitalizzazione del processi.
La piccola dimensione aziendale non è sempre favorevole alla conciliazione dei tempi di
lavoro, nonostante il ruolo della dimensione sia meno vincolante grazie alla
dematerializzazione e alla digitalizzazione.
Orari e rapporti di lavoro flessibili sono oggi al centro dell’attenzione per le possibili
ripercussioni negative sulla società, in particolare quando molte persone sperimentano solo
lavori precari con orari non standard.
Ci sarà sempre una cintura di occupati flessibili intorno alle occupazioni strutturate
tradizionalmente.
Per valutare l’impatto sociale, è importante osservare i flussi dall’una all’altra posizione, la
permanenza media nella posizione flessibile e la durata della transizione.
La permanenza e la durata della transizione sono in aumento e rappresentano una sfida per
i sistemi retributivi e previdenziali per garantire l’efficacia e l’equità. Inoltre, potrebbe essere
necessario pagare di più per la flessibilità piuttosto che negarne l’importanza
Tuttavia, questo potrebbe non essere sufficiente per risolvere il problema.
Riduzione dell'orario tra esigenze individuali e collettive
Il part-time è la forma più diffusa di flessibilizzazione dell’orario di lavoro, con contratti
orizzontali o verticali. L’aumento dei part-time degli ultimi anni è dovuto anche al part-time
involontario come alternativa alla disoccupazione. Tuttavia, considerazioni di produttività e di
costo del lavoro rallentano l’impiego di questa modalità, che dovrebbe essere valutata non
solo dal punto di vista economico ma anche in termini di benefici e costi per l’azienda.
Il lavoro a tempo parziale rappresenta uno strumento per le imprese per adattare la capacità
produttiva alla domanda e per le persone di conciliare il lavoro con altre esigenze.
La convenienza dell’adozione del part time da parte dell’impresa dipende dai costi fissi di
lavoro e dall’ammontare dei costi di formazione e addestramento. Per questo motivo, il part
time è utilizzato principalmente per posizioni scarsamente qualificate.
La riduzione volontaria dell’orario di lavoro è una misura che nasce dalle esigenze
individuali della persona che desidera avere più tempo per attività di “non lavoro”.
le proposte di riduzione dell’orario di lavoro sono spesso associate a forme di flessibilità
degli orari e modelli alternativi di distribuzione e retribuzione.
l’aumento dei rapporti di lavoro a tempo parziale verificatosi nell’ultimo decennio sembra
dovuto principalmente al part time involontario come alternativa alla disoccupazione.
La part-time, quindi, deve essere oggetto di un’analisi costi-benefici più ampia di quella
strettamente economica, tenendo conto degli aspetti sociali e delle esigenze individuali dei
lavoratori.
Tali proposte sono raggruppabili in due classi
- riduzione congiunturale dell'orario di lavoro a livello di azienda o di un gruppo di aziende
per far fronte a cadute temporanee del livello di attività evitando licenziamenti, ma riducendo
la retribuzione (una variante di tale soluzione è rappresentata dai contratti di solidarietà
realizzati in Italia utilizzando la cassa integrazione a rotazione, con l'effetto di ridurre gli orari,
ma non in dimensione significativa le retribuzioni garantite dall'ammortizzatore sociale)
- riduzione strutturale e generalizzata dell'orario di lavoro, con un abbattimento significativo e
permanente delle ore annuali, mensili e settimanali. La riduzione di orario comporta per
l'impresa un aumento dei costi del lavoro per unità di tempo lavorata e per unità di prodotto
in tutti i casi in cui siano rilevanti i costi fissi del lavoro di natura retributiva e non retributiva.
Questi aumenti non sempre possono essere compensati da:
- un ridimensionamento dell'entità di tali costi e più precisamente trasformando in
proporzionali al tempo lavorato i costi fissi di natura retributiva e riducendo: quelli di natura
non retributiva;- una socializzazione del costi fissi non retributivi, soprattutto in ordine alla formazione del capitale umano, - un miglioramento del clima aziendale che dovrebbe essere possibile quando la riduzione dell'orario del lavoro è fortemente condivisa per motivazioni di ordine sla individuale sia sociale; - un più elevato tasso di utilizzazione degli impianti (quando la riduzione di orario individuale si accompagna a flessibilità nei turni)

il futuro del lavoro è strettamente legato alla capacità delle imprese di innovare, generare conoscenza e utilizzare efficacemente quella già esistente, ma anche alla capacità delle persone di adattarsi alle nuove sfide e di acquisire nuove competenze. La digital transformation può migliorare l'organizzazione del lavoro, ma è importante utilizzare meglio le persone in fase di espulsione dai processi produttivi e formarle a interagire con macchine e robot per potenziare le proprie competenze.

Use literature as support: 2 – 5 citations (family name, year).
Use theory / concepts to put your topic into context. They might have also been mentioned in your title.

 
Literature review
• What does the existing literature say about the topic?
• What are the strengths and limitations of existing studies on the topic, if any?
• How do the discussions in the existing literature contribute to the formulation of your research questions?

Key issues / findings relevant to your topic – list form, not sentences. This is not an essay. Talk through issues.
Key concepts related to the issues. Which will you focus on? Which is suitable to answer your question?
Put the citation next to the key words.
Mention the gap in the literature which justifies the research.

 
Research Questions and/or Hypotheses
• What are the research questions (including major and minor) and/or hypotheses?

Present the research questions and/or hypotheses.
They must be focused and narrowed down. 
They must interesting and relevant. 

 
Methods
• What are the research design and method(s) and why?
• What primary data will you gather?
• Which sampling strategy, if any, will you use and why?
• What, if any, are the potential problems you anticipate while doing the research, including gaining access to documents, organizations and people?

1.1 Основное назначение: Функциональный комплекс «ТАРИФНЫЕ ОПЦИИ» (TRFOPTIONS) предоставляет сотрудникам центра обслуживания возможность назначать персонализированные тарифные предложения по абоненту или лицевому счету (всем абонентам клиента)

1.2 Реализация: управление реализуется через визуальный интерфейс подсистемы SBMS_TRAFFIC_DISC посредством вызова функций OAPI. Шаблоны тарифных предложений (таблица RATING_OFFER_TEMPLATES) можно задать в подсистеме "Тарифы" (TRF).

Шаблон представляет собой назначаемые на клиента/абонента тарификационные профили (таблица RATING_PROFILES), формирующиеся из базовых технологических профилей:

SERVICE_PROFILES (профили услуг) – содержат описание бизнес-понятия «услуга» в виде набора комбинаций значений справочников услуг (SERV_LISTS), логических вызовов (LOGIC_CALLS) и тарифных классов (RATING_GROUPS); 
LOCATION_PROFILES (профили местоположения) – могут содержать (опционально) описание бизнес-понятия «местоположения» совершения вызова в виде набора комбинаций значений справочников типов зональности (ZONE_TYPES), стран (COUNTRIES), операторов – партнеров по роумингу (ROAM_OPERATORS), зон (ZONES) и типов роуминга (ROAMING_TYPES); DIRECTION_PROFILES (профили направления) – могут содержать (опционально) описание бизнес-понятия «направления» совершения вызова в виде набора комбинаций значений справочников направлений (DIRECTIONS), префиксов телефонных номеров (PREFIX_SETS), стран (COUNTRIES), направлений на тарифном плане (RATE_PLAN_DIRECTIONS) и логических вызовов (LOGIC_CALLS). 
Т.е. можно отдельно настроить и локально, и для роуминга, и для какого-то конкретного направления вызова.Также поддерживается возможность создания несовместимости тарифных профилей, проверка которой осуществляется на уровне одного владельца - абонента или клиента.

Приоритет тарифного предложения выбирается исходя из минимального значения стоимости сначала на абоненте, а затем на клиенте.

Стоимость задаётся с учётом налога. Сама величина налога задаётся параметром BIS_RATING_STD_SRLS_TAX_DEFAULT подсистемы HRS_CONFIG

PROCESS MINING: A REQUIREMENT FOR HYPERAUTOMATION?
Hyperautomation requires an accurate view of the performance of your existing processes and how they work.

Modern cardiac surgery requires a wide range of pharmacology perioperatively and would be impossible without many currently available medications. Patients may receive several therapeutic agents throughout the perioperative period that affect cardiovascular (CV), pulmonary, and hematological functions (Rivera et al., 2021). Accordingly, members of the cardiac surgery team require an acute understanding of the available pharmacologic agents to safely manage patients and promote good outcomes. In order to facilitate the knowledge acquisition of common medications used in cardiac surgery, the medication profile of a fictitious surgical case study will be analyzed below, chronicling a patient’s medical journey – prehospital and perioperatively (emergency department, operating room, intensive care unit, and discharge).
Case Study & Patient Health History
The following case report describes a 23-year-old male trauma patient that suffered an unfortunate sporting accident causing cardiac arrest, presumably due to commotio cordis, and further resulting in DeBakey type II aortic dissection, requiring emergency aortic surgery (Bentall procedure) with cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB).
The accident occurred during a competitive university hockey game when the young man was quickly skating up the ice when an opposing player suddenly elbowed him extremely hard at a high rate of speed, with the principal point of contact being his sternum. The young man collapsed to the ice and went into immediate cardiac arrest from presumed commotio cordis (Link, 2012). Team trainers immediately initiated cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) and defibrillation. Ground paramedic services quickly responded to the call and assumed care. Defibrillation was eventually successful, and the patient was intubated for airway protection and transported to the nearest trauma facility. Unfortunately, the patient suffered a DeBakey type II aortic dissection requiring surgical intervention. Following a complicated aortic surgery, the patient had an uneventful postoperative recovery and was eventually discharged home.
The patient is 23 years old (182 cm, 83 kg) with a medical history of juvenile diabetes (Type I), managed with an insulin pump; he was also diagnosed with mild type 1 Von Willebrand Disease (VWD), and Ehlers-Danlos syndrome in his youth. The patient has never been previously hospitalized, and the only medication he takes is insulin (fast-acting insulin aspart via an insulin pump, variable dosing [units/hr])(Berget et al., 2019).
Patient Medication Profile
Prehospital
Advanced cardiac life support (ACLS) protocols were initiated when paramedics assumed patient care CPR efforts were continued; simultaneously, intraosseous (IO) access was obtained to administer resuscitation medications and intravenous (IV) fluids (American Heart Association [AHA], 2020). A 1 mg IO dose of rescue epinephrine was administered to the patient to stimulate sympathetic adrenergic cardiac activity (beta1 receptors) to facilitate electrical rhythm conversion and resuscitation (London Health Sciences Center [LHSC], 2023). A 1 L IO fluid bolus of Lactated Ringer’s (LR) crystalloid was also provided to help circulate the epinephrine and support the patient’s cardiovascular circulation and blood pressure (BP). Defibrillation attempts were repeated every two minutes per ACLS guidelines until the return of spontaneous circulation (ROSC) was obtained (AHA, 2020); obtunded consciousness and ROSC were achieved following the fourth defibrillation attempt.
To protect the patient’s airway, paramedics elected to intubate the patient. Rapid sequence intubation was utilized using the following medications: 25 mcg of fentanyl (opioid analgesic) was provided for pre-induction analgesia, a low dose due to hypotension with mean arterial pressure (MAP) of 58 mmHg post-ROSC, and a combination of ketamine use (also having analgesic properties); 100 mg (1-2 mg/kg) ketamine IO (general anesthetic) was administered for primary induction agent; and 100 mg (0.6-1.2 mg/kg) rocuronium IO (non-depolarizing neuromuscular blocker) to facilitate airway relaxation for endotracheal tube insertion (LHSC, 2023). These medications provided the five critical components of general anesthesia (hypnosis, amnesia, analgesia, inhibition of autonomic and sensory reflexes, and muscle relaxation)(McNair, 2023). Following intubation, the patient was started on a 1.2 mg/kg continuous infusion of ketamine (1-5 mg/kg) for maintenance of sedation.
On transport to the hospital, the patient continued to be hypotensive (MAP 59 mmHg) and was in a sinus tachycardia with a heart rate of 127 beats per minute (BPM); another 1 L of LR was administered to increase blood pressure, and a low dose of continuous IO norepinephrine infusion was started at 6 mcg/min (sympathomimetic inotrope/vasopressor) to simulate beta1 receptors to increase myocardial contractility and peripheral alpha1 vascular receptors to vasoconstrict, which increased the patient’s BP to a MAP of 66 mmHg (LHSC, 2023). The patient was successfully transported to the nearest trauma centre.
Emergency Department
Following arrival to the emergency room and brief neurologic assessment, the patient’s continuous IV sedation was changed based on institution protocols: propofol (general anesthetic, 1-5 mg/kg/hr) was started at 1.5 mg/kg/hr for maintenance of sedation, and 1 mg/hr hydromorphone (opioid analgesic, 0-5 mg/hr) was initiated for analgesia. Norepinephrine IV infusion was continued at 10mcg/min to increase MAP to 70 mmHg. Vasopressin (vasopressor, 0.9-2.4 units/hr) continuous IV infusion was also started at 1.8 units/hr for persistent hypotension to induce renal vasoconstriction (V1) and water reabsorption (V2)(LHSC, 2023). In addition, right radial arterial BP monitoring was established, and right internal jugular central venous access was inserted for medication and fluid administration.
Patient bloodwork (ABG, CBC, electrolytes, INR/PTT, fibrinogen) was completed following arterial and central line insertion (Appendix, Table 1), and reported low hemoglobin (69 g/L) and hematocrit (20.7 %), which was concerning for internal bleeding and hemodilution related crystalloid fluid resuscitation; mild prolonged coagulation studies (INR 1.3, PTT 47) were also noted, likely related to the patient’s VWD history, and reflecting a degree of trauma-induced coagulopathy (TIC) (Kornblith et al., 2019). Arterial blood gas demonstrated a mixed metabolic acidosis with a plasma lactate of 3.1 mmol/L. Two units of packed red blood cells (PRBC) were administered at this time for volume resuscitation and suspected bleeding; the patient was rushed to the CT (computed tomography) suite for emergent imaging.
CT Suite.
Several concerning findings were noted on the CT scan, including an acute ascending aortic dissection (DeBakey Type II), bilateral rib fractures, right pneumothorax, and myocardial contusions. As the patient was removed from the CT scanner, his BP precipitously dropped (MAP 50 mmHg) and was not responding to increased vasopressors (norepinephrine at 28 mcg/min, vasopressin 2.4 units/hr). The emergency nurse administered another 1 L LR fluid bolus and pushed 200 mcg IV phenylephrine (alpha1 adrenergic agonist vasopressor), which caused peripheral vasoconstriction and increased the patient’s MAP to 54 mmHg (LHSC, 2023). The emergency physician ordered a massive transfusion protocol, and blood quickly arrived at the CT suite; two more units of PRBC were immediately administered, and the patient’s MAP increased to 63 mmHg. Cardiovascular Surgery was emergently consulted, and the patient’s parents provided emergency telephone consent for a Bentall procedure for ascending aorta replacement; the patient was brought directly to the operating room (OR) for aortic surgery.
Operating Room 
On arrival to the OR, 1g (5-20 mg/kg) IV tranexamic acid (hemostatic agent) was administered to the patient in anticipation of potential significant hemorrhage (Vallerand, 2023); 1g IV cefazolin (cephalosporin) was also provided for prophylactic anti-infective purposes (Vallerand, 2023). Anesthesia medications were also adjusted in preparation for surgery: propofol was increased to 3 mg/kg/hr; hydromorphone infusion was exchanged with a 1.5 mcg/kg/hr fentanyl infusion for improved intraoperative analgesia; a rocuronium infusion was also started (1.2 mg/kg/hr) to maintain muscular paralysis to facilitate surgery (Vallerand, 2023); Sevoflurane (0.5-2%)(inhaled general anesthetic) was also available during CPB for additional sedation and management of intraoperative hypertension if required (DrugBank Online, 2023). The anesthetist administered a loading dose of 35 000 IU (400 IU/kg) of unfractionated IV heparin sulphate for systemic anticoagulation for CPB (LHSC, 2023); the perfusionist primed the CPB circuit with 1 L Plasmalyte A, 10 000 IU heparin, and three units of PRBC (calculated on-pump hematocrit 17%); anesthesia also administered PRBC to the patient. Due to patient instability, the team elected not to wait for an activated clotting time (ACT)> 480 seconds to initiate CPB. Once the perfusionist confirmed that anesthesia administered heparin, emergency CPB was initiated following one minute of heparin circulation. The ACT peaked at >999 seconds during the case due to the large heparin bolus, VWD, and TIC (Kornblith et al., 2019). 
Intraoperatively, the patient experienced significant hypotension and vasoplegia, in addition to anemia from moderate blood losses, requiring multiple blood transfusions throughout the case (two units PRBC, two units fresh frozen plasma (FFP), 1 unit of platelets, and 200 mL 25% albumin) to maintain oxygen carrying capacity, coagulation factors, and BP; hemodynamics were also supported with IV vasopressors (norepinephrine 26 mcg/min, vasopressin 2.4 units/hr, and CPB push-dose phenylephrine (100-200 mcg increments) to keep patient MAP > 55 mmHg.
Bloodwork was repeated intraoperatively (Appendix, Table 2) and demonstrated persistent metabolic acidosis, rising lactate, low venous oxygen saturation, and hypocalcemia; the perfusionist increased CPB flows, continued to monitor ionized calcium levels (which would be corrected following cross-clamp removal), and administered 100 mEq of sodium bicarbonate IV (alkalinizing agent) for severe metabolic acidosis (BE -10.6 mEq/L), which improved the patient’s acidosis (Vallerand, 2023). 
The perfusionist rewarmed the patient following aortic repair; during this time, they administered several anesthesia maintenance medications (50 mcg IV fentanyl for analgesia, 2 mg IV midazolam [benzodiazepine] for sedation, and 50 mg IV rocuronium for pharmacologic paralysis). When the cross-clamp was removed, the perfusionist administered 2 g IV magnesium sulphate (membrane stabilizer) to prevent fibrillation and 1 g IV calcium chloride for its positive inotropy effects and treatment of hypocalcemia. Weaning from bypass was complicated by severe myocardial stunning, requiring intra-aortic balloon pump (IABP) initiation (via left femoral artery), in addition to a 10 mcg/kg/hr continuous IV infusion of dobutamine (positive inotrope) to improve cardiac contractility and cardiac output (Vallerand, 2023). Once CPB was discontinued, 350 mg IV protamine sulphate (heparin reversal antidote, 1 mg/100 IU heparin) was administered to reverse the effects of heparin (LHSC, 2023); an ACT of 150 seconds was achieved. A low-dose heparin anticoagulation protocol (aPTT 50-64s) was then initiated at 6 units/kg/hr (IV continuous infusion) for IABP therapy (Figure 1)(LHSC, 2023). The patient was then transported to the cardiovascular intensive care unit (CVICU) for recovery. 
Figure 1. Low-Dose Anticoagulation Protocol (LHSC, 2023).
 
Postoperative Recovery 
Cardiovascular Intensive Care Unit.
On CVICU admission, the patient’s hemodynamic support requirements continued to be high, requiring multiple IV vasopressors (norepinephrine 19 mcg/min, vasopressin 2.4 units/hr), inotropes (dobutamine 10 mcg/kg/min), and IABP (heparin at 6 units/kg/hr). Patient sedation was managed with continuous IV propofol (1.5 mg/kg/hr) and hydromorphone (1 mg/hr). Sedation, vasopressor, and ventilator support were weaned and discontinued as the patient tolerated clinically. Subcutaneous dalteparin (5000 units once daily), a low molecular weight heparin (LMWH), was administered to the patient for prophylaxis of venous thromboembolism following discontinuation of the IABP and IV heparin. The patient received daily subcutaneous LMWH until discharged (LHSC, 2023). 
The patient experienced rapid atrial fibrillation postoperatively, for which IV amiodarone (antiarrhythmic) was administered; a 150 mg IV loading bolus over ten minutes, followed by a 60 mg/hr continuous IV infusion for the following 48 hours, which eventually converted the patient back into a sinus rhythm (LHSC, 2023). In addition to atrial fibrillation, the patient also experienced postoperative fluid overload and pulmonary congestion, for which 40 mg IV direct furosemide (loop diuretic) was provided every eight hours and facilitated urinary diuresis and excretion of excess vascular volume (Vallerand, 2023). Inhaled salbutamol (inhaled bronchodilator) 6 puffs every four hours while invasively ventilated was provided to mitigate atelectasis and ventilator-associated pneumonia, and keeping the head-of-bed greater than 30 degrees (Dhand, 2017); ventilator support was reduced with these strategies. Continuous IV insulin regular (antihyperglycemic hormone) was provided to the patient to maintain blood glucose levels of 4.5-6.5 mmol/L; the initial starting dose was 2 units/hr and was titrated with frequent blood glucose checks to avoid potential hypoglycemia (LHSC, 2023). 
A nasogastric feeding tube was inserted on ICU arrival to administer enteral nutrition and oral medications to the patient until extubated. Oral medications the patient received during ICU stay included: metoprolol (beta-blocker) 25 mg every 12 hours to reduce BP and prevent aortic graft stress; amlodipine (calcium channel blocker) 10 mg once daily to aid in further BP reduction; atorvastatin (statin) 40 mg once daily to facilitate the management of cholesterol and BP; quetiapine (antipsychotic) 25 mg oral every eight hours was administered for its sedative effects to facilitate weaning from IV sedation and invasive ventilation; daily 81 mg aspirin (antiplatelet agent) therapy was started for its antiplatelet activity to prevent platelet aggregation to Gore-Tex vascular aortic graft (following IABP discontinuation), and lansoprazole (proton pump inhibitor) 30 mg once daily while in-hospital for prophylaxis of gastric stress ulcers (stress response to critical illness) was also provided (De Martino et al., 2014; Vallerand et al., 2023). The patient was extubated after 48 hours and transferred to the inpatient cardiovascular ward following another two days in ICU. Daily blood work was also completed in ICU; electrolytes and hematology were stabilized before the patient was transferred to the inpatient ward (Appendix, Table 3). 
Discharge
The patient spent four additional days in the inpatient cardiovascular ward before being discharged home. The patient was alert and mobilizing daily, all body systems were functioning, and bloodwork was within normal ranges. The patient was provided with the following medication scripts upon discharge: metoprolol 12.5 mg every 12 hours, amlodipine 10mg once daily, aspirin 81 mg once daily, 500 mg acetaminophen (nonopioid analgesic, antipyretic) for analgesia, 1 mg hydromorphone every 6 hours as needed for breakthrough pain, and lactulose (osmotic laxative) 30 mL (20 g)(as needed every hour until effect) was also prescribed to prevent constipation from opioids and to prevent stress on the aorta and graft (Vallerand, 2023). The patient was warned not to exceed 4g of acetaminophen daily due to the risk of overdose and liver injury, in addition to the potential hazards of opioids, including overdose and the possibility of dependence. 
Conclusion
The success of patients undergoing cardiac surgery in the modern era heavily relies on the use of a broad range of pharmacologic agents throughout the perioperative period. The patient case study illustrated in this report emphasizes the critical role of pharmacology in managing patients undergoing CV surgery. The patient was administered personalized medications from the prehospital phase to discharge home to meet their physiological and perioperative needs. It is crucial for the cardiac surgery team to possess a thorough understanding of available pharmacologic agents to ensure safe and effective patient management. Healthcare professionals must stay informed of the latest CV medications and their appropriate indications to continue providing the best possible patient care. While drugs such as beta-blockers, vasopressors, inotropes, antiplatelets, and anticoagulants are essential in cardiac surgery, their administration may lead to side effects and complications that the surgical team must manage. Thus, having comprehensive knowledge of CV medications is critical for promoting positive surgical outcomes and providing optimal care to patients throughout the perioperative period.

对下面的文字进行润色，奇安信CERT研究并发布的全网漏洞态势研究2022年度报告[3]表明，目前网络攻防形势严峻，各类安全事件层出不穷。在各种网络攻击中，除了SQL注人和XSS这些老问题，近几年反序列化这种攻击方式愈发严重。在2017年OWASP发布了新的十大web漏洞威胁，其中A8:2017就是不安全的反序列化[4]，A9:2017-使用含有已知漏洞的组件也和反序列化紧密相连，这是因为在PHP以及Java开发中很多代码都依赖于第三方组件，而这些组件可能会存在反序列漏洞。PHP 反序列化或对象注入漏洞最早发生在2009年[5]，它可导致攻击者通过向 unserialized () PHP 函数提供恶意输入的方法执行多种攻击。反序列化漏洞最早出现在php语言中，但不只存在于PHP中，近年来在Java、Python等面向对象语言的应用中也频繁出现。相较于其他漏洞，利用反序列化漏洞能够直接进行远程代码执行、本地文件读写等多种高危操作，大部分情况下攻击成本低且造成的危害巨大。根据W3Techs2019年12月6号发布的统计数据，PHP在WEB网站服务器端使用的编程语言所占份额高达78.9%[1]，存在的反序列化漏洞更多。以CVE-2015—8562漏洞为例，受影响的网站几乎日均受到16000次黑客扫描攻击[6]，说明了该漏洞攻击的危害程度之大。
然而针对PHP反序列化漏洞的研究主要集中在PHP反序列化链的自动化检测上，然而对于如何发现一个可控的反序列化漏洞点仍然缺少一个合适的工具。现阶段主要还是利用自动化审计工具通过人工阅读Web应用程序的源代码进行代码审计，寻找反序列化漏洞的特征，如使用PHP内置的反序列化函数 unserialize()，在反序列化之前没有进行数据的过滤和校验等，这种方式准确率比较高，但是效率不高。
因此如何快速检测反序列化漏洞成为Web安全领域一个亟待解决的问题。通过对PHP序列化机制和反序列化漏洞的研究发现，在所有的反序列化攻击中，反序列化漏洞大部分是调用unserialize反序列化敏感函数或者是通过phar协议[8]来触发常见文件相关协议如if_file函数实现的。当攻击者从浏览器中输入带有恶意语句的参数在未经过滤或者过滤不严的情况下流向反序列化敏感函数时，就有可能导致漏洞的发生。
根据上述研究本文基于动态污点分析技术设计了一种自动化检测反序列化漏洞的系统，以PHP扩展的形式实现，快速集成到待检测PHPWeb应用环境中去，并通过网络爬虫进行爬取触发反序列化敏感函数，快速定位触发反序列化漏洞点如unserialize敏感函数的堆栈信息帮助还原漏洞机理，实现PHP反序列化漏洞快速准确自动化检测。

2009年，Stefan Essar介绍了一种针对PHPWeb应用程序中的对象注入能力的攻击方法[10，11]，该方法滥用攻击者的能力，通过反序列化来任意修改注入到给定Web应用程序中对象的属性实现魔术方法的一系列调用实现攻击。自从Essar提出PHP反序列化问题以来，已经有大量的CVE出现，例如CVE- 2017-12932、CVE-2017-12933、CVE-2017-12934等。在过去的几年里，更是在流行的开源PHP内容管理系统（如WordPress、Drupal、Joomla和Piwik）中检测到了许多反序列化漏洞。它们可能导致严重的安全漏洞，如远程代码执行，并影响大多数Web服务器。反序列化在过去和最近几年都有大量出现，如表所示介绍了七个被重新定义为反序列化漏洞的记录在案的CVE。

近期出现的php反序列化漏洞
CVE-2020-36326  phpmailer
CVE-2019-6339  Drupal
CVE-2018-20148  WordPress
CVE-2018-19296  phpmailer
CVE-2018-1000525  OpenPSA2
CVE-2016-8580  Alienvault
CVE-2014-2294  Open Web Analytics

在对给定Web应用程序中的数据进行反序列化的过程中，当输入未经过消毒时，种格式使传输复杂的数据结构变得容易，并且经常被误用来创建多维cookie和类似的数据结构。由于PHP允许对任意对象进行反序列化，攻击者可以将具有任意属性集的专门准备的对象插入到应用程序中。 根据应用程序实现的不同，攻击者可以触发内部PHP魔法函数，这反过来又可能导致几个漏洞，如代码注入、SQL注入、路径遍历和应用程序拒绝服务，这取决于上下文。比如CVE-2016-8580中Alienvault OSSIM和USM存在对象注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者利用漏洞提交特殊请求注入任意对象到应用程序，删除文件，查看文件，执行本地脚本代码。在CVE-2018-20148中使得攻击者可借助特制的元数据利用该漏洞实施PHP对象注入攻击WordPress 5.0.1之前版本，造成远程命令执行。PHPMailer (CVE-2020-36326, CVE-2018-19296)中的PHP反序列化漏洞，通过传入可控的路径参数到addatattach函数中经过is_file触发[13]。CVE-2019-6339使攻击者利用该漏洞在Drupal后台执行任意的php代码[14]。
针对逐渐增多的php反序列化漏洞，越来越多的安全研究人员开始了对php反序列化漏洞的检测。2013年，Imperva发布的《黑客智能倡议每月趋势报告》第17期分析了反序列化漏洞CVE-2010-3065[15]。2014年，DAHSE等人系统化地分析了对象注入漏洞如何通过POP链进行利用，并通过静态扫描检测对象注入漏洞[16]。在2014年，J Dahse等人引入了一种自动方法来静态检测面向对象PHP代码中的POI漏洞，并能够以自动的方式生成POP链[20]。2018年，陈震杭等人将PHP的敏感函数调用栈作为研究出发点,以Web应用正常运行时的函数调用栈作为判定依据,实现了一个基于PHP敏感函数调用栈的未知反序列化漏洞动态检测与拦截系统[17]。2019年，Koutroumpouchos等人提出ObjectMap工具，用于检测基于Java和PHP的Web应用程序中的反序列化和对象注入功能[18]，但是该工具只能检测所传入HTTP数据包中存在漏洞的参数，并不能给出漏洞发生的堆栈信息。2022年，Sunnyeo Park等人结合了动静态分析以及模糊测试技术，提出了一种可以用于挖掘并利用PHP反序列化漏洞的工具fugio[19]。除此之外，国内也产生一款基于.QL概念搭建好的自动化寻找php反序列化链简单模型phpunserializechain[21]。
目前国内外对反序列化漏洞的研究都主要集中在PHP反序列化链的构造和发掘上，而对于检测PHP反序列化漏洞点并未给出一个全面的方案。比如fugio能够通过静态分析收集所有类和函数信息，以识别所有可用的gadget，经过反馈驱动的模糊处理后，生成利用对象并跟踪已识别链的执行情况，但是对于如何检测发现PHP反序列化漏洞如可控的unserizlize函数并没有给出合适的解决方法。对于这方面的研究，主要还是使用静态检测工具对php源码进行分析，通过正则匹配敏感函数规则的方式或者是利用AST抽象语法树生成程序模型的方式来寻找反序列化漏洞点，例如PHP自动化审计工具seay[7]、RIPS[9]，但是由于静态源代码分析的局限性，需要消耗大量计算成本用于应用程序源代码的解析，而且漏洞是否真正存在也仍然需要代码审计者确认，在漏洞准确率和自动化程度上仍然存在不足。

Palsgraf v. Long Island R. Co. - 248 N.Y. 339
RULE:
If no hazard is apparent to the eye of ordinary vigilance, an act innocent and harmless, at least to outward seeming, with reference to a plaintiff, does not take to itself the quality of a tort because it happened to be a wrong, though apparently not one involving the risk of bodily insecurity, with reference to someone else. In every instance, before negligence can be predicated of a given act, back of the act must be sought and found a duty to the individual complaining, the observance of which would have averted or avoided the injury. The ideas of negligence and duty are strictly correlative.

FACTS:
Plaintiff ticket-holding passenger Helen Palsgraf was standing on a platform of defendant Long Island Railroad Company. A man carrying a package jumped aboard the car of a moving train at a nearby platform. A guard in the car reached to help him in, and a guard on the platform pushed the man from behind. The package was dislodged, fell onto the rails, and exploded. The shock of the explosion caused a scales to fall onto plaintiff passenger, who filed this lawsuit for injuries due to defendant's alleged negligence. The trial term court (the Supreme Court) entered a verdict for plaintiff. In 1927, the Supreme Court, Appellate Division affirmed the judgment in favor of plaintiff. These two lower courts held that the negligent acts of the railroad's employees caused the package that contained explosives to be thrown under the train where they exploded. Defendant railroad sought appeal to the Court of Appeals of New York.

(Procedural note: In the New York state court system, the Supreme Court is the trial level. The Supreme Court of New York, Appellate Division hears cases on first appeal. The highest court is the Court of Appeals of New York -- this is the court for the instant decision.)

ISSUE:
In an action for injuries sustained during an explosion when a package was dropped on a nearby rail, was defendant railroad liable for negligence due to its guards' conduct in pushing the man carrying the package?

ANSWER:
No

CONCLUSION:
In 1928, the Court of Appeals of New York reversed the judgments of the appellate division and the trial term of the Supreme Court. Ruling in favor of defendant railroad, the Court dismissed plaintiff passenger's complaint. The Court found that the conduct of the railroad's guards was not a wrong or negligence in relation to plaintiff, standing far away. There was nothing in the situation to suggest to the most cautious mind that the parcel wrapped in newspaper would spread wreckage through the station. The Court explained that negligence is not actionable unless it involves the invasion of a legally protected interest--the violation of a right, which in this case was claimed to be the right to be protected against interference with one's bodily security. Bodily security is not protected against all forms of interference or aggression, but only against some. Negligence is the absence of care, according to the circumstances. The Court concluded that there was no negligence because defendant railroad could not have reasonably foreseen that its employees' conduct would have resulted in injury to plaintiff Palsgraff. The Court noted that the plaintiff had sued in her own right for a wrong personal to her, and not as the vicarious beneficiary of a breach of duty to another.

A visual content-based website classification was selected to identify gambling and pornographic websites. The SURF model parameters in the BOW model were found to be effective in identifying screenshots of gambling and pornographic websites, and were implemented to distinguish gambling and pornographic websites from normal websites using support vector machines (SVM) by extracting visual features from each webpage screenshot based on the BoW model.
	The article Automatic Detection of Pornographic and Gambling Websites Based on Visual and Textual Content Using a Decision Mechanism[2], proposed the use of Doc2Vec to learn the textual features of the textual content in the hypertext markup language (HTML) source code of a website。In addition, the traditional bag of visual words (BoVW) is improved to better represent the visual features of web screenshots by introducing local spatial relationships of feature points. Then, based on these two types of features, a text classifier and an image classifier are trained to make predictions through a decision mechanism. 根据下面文字写一篇文献综述。奇安信CERT最新发布的2022年度全网漏洞态势研究报告显示，当前网络攻防形势愈发严峻，各类安全事件层出不穷[3]。近年来，反序列化成为网络攻击中越来越严重的问题之一，除了SQL注入和XSS等老问题。OWASP在2017年发布的十大web漏洞威胁中，不安全的反序列化[4]和使用含有已知漏洞的组件分别位列榜单前列。由于很多PHP和Java开发程序都依赖于第三方组件，这些组件可能存在反序列化漏洞，因此，反序列化攻击与已知漏洞的组件使用是密切相关的。PHP反序列化或对象注入漏洞最早在2009年被发现[5]，攻击者可以通过向unserialize() PHP函数提供恶意输入，执行多种恶意攻击。尽管反序列化漏洞最早在PHP语言中出现，但近年来在Java、Python等面向对象语言的应用中也频繁出现。与其他漏洞相比，利用反序列化漏洞可以直接进行远程代码执行、本地文件读写等多种高危操作，造成的危害极大，而且攻击成本较低。根据W3Techs发布的统计数据，PHP在WEB网站服务器端使用的编程语言份额高达78.9%[1]，反序列化漏洞更为普遍，例如CVE-2015—8562漏洞就几乎每日受到16000次黑客扫描攻击[6]，其危害程度之大不容小觑。
然而，针对PHP反序列化漏洞的研究主要集中在PHP反序列化链的自动化检测上。对于如何发现一个可控的反序列化漏洞点，仍然缺乏一个合适的工具。目前，主要利用自动化审计工具人工阅读Web应用程序的源代码进行代码审计，查找反序列化漏洞的特征，如使用PHP内置的反序列化函数unserialize()时，是否进行了数据的过滤和校验等。虽然这种方法具有较高的准确率，但效率不高。
因此，Web安全领域急需解决如何快速检测反序列化漏洞的问题。通过对PHP序列化机制和反序列化漏洞的研究，发现在反序列化攻击中，大部分都是通过调用unserialize反序列化敏感函数或者是通过phar协议[8]触发常见文件相关协议，如if_file函数实现的。当用户输入带有恶意语句的参数流向反序列化敏感函数时，未经过滤或过滤不严，就可能导致漏洞的发生。
根据上述研究，本文基于动态污点分析技术，设计了一种自动化检测PHP反序列化漏洞的系统，以PHP扩展的形式快速集成到待检测PHPWeb应用环境中。通过网络爬虫进行爬取触发反序列化敏感函数，快速定位触发反序列化漏洞点，例如unserialize敏感函数的堆栈信息，有助于还原漏洞机理。这种方法可以提高反序列化漏洞检测的效率和准确率，为Web应用的安全提供更加可靠的解决方案。

在2009年，Stefan Essar提出了一种针对PHP Web应用程序中的对象注入能力的攻击方法[10, 11]。通过滥用攻击者的能力，借助反序列化过程，任意修改注入到给定Web应用程序中的对象属性，实现魔术方法的逐步调用，进而完成攻击。自Essar提出PHP反序列化问题以来，已出现大量CVE，如CVE-2017-12932，CVE-2017-12933，CVE-2017-12934等。在过去几年里，许多开源PHP内容管理系统（如WordPress，Drupal，Joomla和Piwik）也发现了许多反序列化漏洞。这些漏洞可能导致远程代码执行等严重安全问题，影响大部分Web服务器。反序列化漏洞在过去和最近几年频繁出现（如表所示的七个反序列化漏洞的备案CVE）。

在给定Web应用程序中的数据反序列化过程中，当输入未经过消毒时，种格式使传输复杂数据结构变得容易，并且经常被误用来创建多维cookie和类似数据结构。由于PHP允许对任意对象进行反序列化，攻击者可以将具备任意属性集的专门准备的对象插入应用程序。根据应用程序实现的差异，攻击者可以触发内部PHP魔法函数，这反过来可能导致诸如代码注入、SQL注入、路径遍历和应用程序拒绝服务等漏洞，具体取决于上下文。例如，在CVE-2016-8580中，Alienvault OSSIM和USM存在对象注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者利用漏洞提交特殊请求注入任意对象到应用程序，删除文件，查看文件，执行本地脚本代码。在CVE-2018-20148中，攻击者可以通过特制元数据利用该漏洞实施PHP对象注入攻击，影响WordPress 5.0.1之前的版本，导致远程命令执行。PHPMailer（CVE-2020-36326，CVE-2018-19296）中的PHP反序列化漏洞通过传入可控路径参数到addAttachment函数后，经过is_file触发[13]。CVE-2019-6339使攻击者利用漏洞在Drupal后台执行任意PHP代码[14]。

针对日益增多的PHP反序列化漏洞，越来越多的安全研究人员开始探讨PHP反序列化漏洞的检测。例如，Imperva发布的《黑客智能倡议每月趋势报告》第17期分析了反序列化漏洞CVE-2010-3065[15]。2014年，Dahse等研究者系统化地分析了对象注入漏洞如何通过POP链进行利用，并通过静态扫描检测对象注入漏洞[16]。2014年，J Dahse等人引入了一种自动方法来静态检测面向对象PHP代码中的POI漏洞，并能够以自动方式生成POP链[20]。2018年，陈震杭等人将PHP的敏感函数调用栈作为研究出发点，以Web应用正常运行时的函数调用栈作为判定依据，实现了一个基于PHP敏感函数调用栈的未知反序列化漏洞动态检测与拦截系统[17]。2019年，Koutroumpouchos等人提出ObjectMap工具，用于检测基于Java和PHP的Web应用程序中的反序列化和对象注入功能[18]；但该工具只能检测所传入HTTP数据包中存在漏洞的参数，并不能给出漏洞发生的堆栈信息。2022年，Sunnyeo Park等人结合动、静态分析和模糊测试技术，提出了一种用于挖掘并利用PHP反序列化漏洞的工具——fugio[19]。此外，还有一款基于QL概念搭建的php反序列化链简单模型—phpunserializechain[21]。

尽管如此，目前国内外对反序列化漏洞的研究主要集中在PHP反序列化链的构造和发掘上，对于检测PHP反序列化漏洞点如可控的unserialize函数并未给出全面方案。例如，fugio能够通过静态分析收集所有类和函数信息，以识别所有可用的gadget，经过反馈驱动的模糊处理后，生成利用对象并跟踪已识别链的执行情况，但未给出如何检测发现PHP反序列化漏洞的合适解决方案。对于这方面的研究，主要还是利用静态检测工具，对PHP源码进行分析，通过正则匹配敏感函数规则的方式或者利用AST抽象语法树生成程序模型的方式，来寻找反序列化漏洞点。例如，PHP自动化审计工具seay[7]和RIPS[9]。但由于静态源代码分析的局限性，需要消耗大量计算成本用于应用程序源代码解析，同时漏洞是否真正存在仍需代码审计者确认。因此，漏洞准确率和自动化程度仍有待提高。

Органы гепарда также имеют приспособления для поддержания его быстрой работы. Гепард использует кислород очень эффективно, и его легкие увеличены в размере. Также они имеют большой сердечный мускул для перекачки большого объема крови во время бега. Когда гепард бежит, его тело может поднять температуру до 41 градуса, что способствует увеличению эффективности потовой железы, которая позволяет гепарду оставаться охлажденным во время сильного нагрева.

В целом, гепард - это замечательный пример эволюции, совершенно приспособившегося к скорости и жизни на саванне.


Гепарды являются полигамными животными, то есть у каждого самца может быть несколько самок. Осенью происходит сезон спаривания, и самцы начинают искать самок. Пара обычно остается вместе в течение нескольких суток или недель, и происходит несколько актов спаривания.

Беременность у гепарда длится от 90 до 95 дней, и каждая самка может родить от одного до восьми детенышей. Самки рождают детенышей на скрытых местах, таких как густые заросли травы. У гепардов очень высокая детность - 70% детенышей выживает в первый год жизни.
Детеныши гепарда рождаются слепыми и без зубов, но они быстро развиваются. Самка кормит детенышей молоком с высоким содержанием белка в течение шести месяцев, а затем начинает учить их охотиться. После года жизни детеныши расходятся по своим делам, а самцы начинают искать самок для спаривания.

Гепарды могут размножаться в любое время года, но активнее всего они в этом плане в период дождей. При достижении половой зрелости, что происходит в два года, у самцов возникают выделения на паху для привлечения самок. Во время спаривания гепарды могут проявлять агрессию и демонстрировать импонирующие танцы и позы.

В целом, гепарды являются очень замечательными животными, которые имеют скорость, грацию и тщательно приспособленные к окружающей среде функции. смотри я прислал тебе этот текст, просто сделай из него 1 большой текст для доклада без потери его предложений которые я написал и его смысла

Rewrite in newsletter blog style with the same wordcount for CEOs and CTOs, 'As businesses continue to strive for operational efficiency, AI-based automation is becoming increasingly popular. However, to successfully implement this new technology, organizations must look beyond their usual processes and begin leveraging process mining. 

Process mining extracts valuable information and insights from event logs, providing accurate visualizations of processes that can be monitored in real-time. Essentially, it’s centered around discovering and refining models of how things function using event logs. While initial applications were limited to traditional business systems like ERP, the use of process mining has now expanded into various technical, human, and business processes.

The improvements in AI and machine learning algorithms have driven innovation in recent years, supporting the analysis and understanding of complex processes. Furthermore, new tools like digital twins have emerged, facilitating the visualization and assessment of intricate processes. These advancements have expanded the horizons of process mining and opened up numerous possibilities for the optimization of efficiency across different processes. One such technology born out of this growth is hyperautomation. 

What’s Hyperautomation?

Hyperautomation combines traditional automation with innovative AI-related technologies like Machine Learning and Deep Learning and information systems automation tools like as BPM, iBPM, iPaaS, Low code/No code, and RPA. This comprehensive approach is of immense benefit and promotes empowered teams, enhanced decision-making, and improved compliance and risk control, particularly when applied to various domains such as customer relationship management, supply chain, and finance.

A business-driven and disciplined approach, hyperautomation is gaining attention as it rapidly identifies and automates as many processes as possible. The foundation of hyperautomation is RPA, which can be fully utilized by integrating it with complementary technologies such as process mining, AI, and analytics. This holistic approach to automation has significant benefits, including cost reduction, improved customer experiences, and streamlined processes.

What are the benefits of Hyperautomation for Enterprises?

Hyperautomation not only contributes to cost reduction, but also helps in improving customer experiences by refining customer journeys and shortening processing times. By optimizing the entire delivery chain, hyperautomation promotes cooperation among different stakeholders, such as suppliers, logistics providers, and carriers. This collaborative approach leads to enhanced efficiency in Order-to-Cash and Procure-to-Pay processes, which can revolutionize the finance sector. Hyperautomation has the potential to transform industries by automating processes across the entire value chain, resulting in increased productivity and competitiveness.

How Does Process Mining Drive Hyperautomation?

To fully leverage the benefits of hyperautomation, however, identifying which business processes to automate can be challenging due to cognitive biases, inaccurate assumptions, and insufficient knowledge of operations. This is where process mining comes into play, providing the necessary precise understanding of process performance. 

Process mining allows organizations to accurately analyze their current processes, identify bottlenecks, and pinpoint areas that can be automated to achieve maximum efficiency. By combining hyperautomation with process mining, businesses can make informed decisions on which processes to automate, leading to successful implementation and optimized outcomes. 

This integration of complementary technologies ensures that hyperautomation is implemented strategically and with a deep understanding of existing processes, enabling organizations to unlock its full potential in driving digital transformation.

Process Mining plays a key role in implementing hyperautomation – allowing us to identify current bottlenecks as well as predict future process changes – ultimately leading to more autonomous systems capable of higher speed and complexity in decision-making. 

Process mining combines data science and process analytics to discover, validate, and improve workflows by mining log data from information systems like ERP or CRM tools. It employs a data-driven approach to optimize processes, uncover bottlenecks, and identify automation opportunities. By examining different perspectives such as control-flow, organizational, case, and time, process mining provides comprehensive insights for decision-making. The IEEE published the Process Mining Manifesto advocating its adoption, while factors like digital transformation and hyperautomation will also drive market growth.

Three main types of process mining, credited to computer scientist Wil van der Aalst, include discovery, conformance, and enhancement. Discovery involves creating process models solely based on event log data, while conformance checks confirm if the intended process model matches the real-world execution. Enhancement, also known as extension or performance mining, utilizes additional information to improve existing process models, optimizing processes and addressing bottlenecks. Overall, process mining plays a critical role in achieving operational excellence and successful digital transformation efforts.

Process mining vs. data mining

While data mining employs various algorithms and methods to explore datasets, process mining analyzes event logs and process-related data to uncover processes. Gaining a thorough understanding of processes involves recognizing trends, patterns, and discrepancies in processes, visualizing actual process flows in detail, identifying automation opportunities, and discovering new ways to boost process efficiency.

How does process mining function?

Process mining tools extract actual process models from raw event logs. By obtaining event logs from each case and combining them, these tools reveal how processes perform in reality. 

The workings of process mining can be understood through the following steps:
Process mining tools integrate with several business systems of record (such as ERP and CRM systems) to gather event logs from the company’s systems.
The tools extract the sequence of activities for each case from the event logs.
At this stage, differences between cases become evident. These disparities arise due to manual adjustments or errors in the process.
After determining the activity sequence for each case, process mining tools begin to “merge” these sequences.
As variations occur, the real process will be more complex than the planned one. This outcome also allows the company to comprehend where its process deviated.

The versatility of process mining in addressing different stages of RPA implementation has proven beneficial. By using it, organizations can identify potential areas for automation within their business processes and prioritize them based on ROI potential. Moreover, process mining plays a critical role in hyperautomation, as it involves integrating various tools and technologies to enhance an organization’s ability to automate work. Data-driven analytics generated by combining analyzed data with AI/ML can help organizations discover new opportunities for optimization and automation.

Effective change management is essential for successful process automation, as well as obtaining leadership buy-in and aligning team incentives. AI is critical to hyperautomation, as it empowers bots to undertake tasks with greater intelligence. Incorporating cognitive technologies like ML, NLP, OCR, and AI into RPA through process mining can significantly enhance process efficiency and accuracy.

Ultimately, process mining can help organizations extract more value from hyperautomation by providing the insights needed to optimize processes, streamline operations, and achieve greater efficiency and effectiveness. As the technology evolves, it is likely to be integrated into other critical use cases, such as compliance, auditing, sustainability, and business architecture, and enable models to access APIs and eliminate repetitive workflows.'

翻译为中文。In the article Identifying Gambling and Porn Websites with Image Recognition[1], after analyzing the current methods of website classification, it is argued that the text content based methods suffer from the curse of dimensionality because the websites become more and more complex and massive. A visual content-based website classification was selected to identify gambling and pornographic websites. The SURF model parameters in the BOW model were found to be effective in identifying screenshots of gambling and pornographic websites, and were implemented to distinguish gambling and pornographic websites from normal websites using support vector machines (SVM) by extracting visual features from each webpage screenshot based on the BoW model.
	The article Automatic Detection of Pornographic and Gambling Websites Based on Visual and Textual Content Using a Decision Mechanism[2], proposed the use of Doc2Vec to learn the textual features of the textual content in the hypertext markup language (HTML) source code of a website。In addition, the traditional bag of visual words (BoVW) is improved to better represent the visual features of web screenshots by introducing local spatial relationships of feature points. Then, based on these two types of features, a text classifier and an image classifier are trained to make predictions through a decision mechanism. In the decision mechanism, a data fusion algorithm based on logistic regression(LR) was designed to obtain the final prediction result by measuring the contribution of the two classification results to the final category prediction and the results are experimented to verify the superiority of this method.
	The article Automatic Image Annotation based on Co-Training[3] points out that training a well-performing model usually requires a large number of labeled samples, and manual annotation is costly, so a new semi-supervised automatic image annotation method based on a co-training algorithm is proposed, which can utilize both labeled and The performance is improved by constructing two different classifiers using the co-training method, and the experimental results show that the method has better labeling performance than many existing automatic image standard methods.
Through reading the above-mentioned literature, we understand that the following problems still exist in the current research on the identification of blackmail websites at home and abroad: (1) insufficient use of webpage content, lack of research on the extraction of a large amount of available textual information in webpage screenshots; (2) using only the unimodal data of images, the identification accuracy needs to be improved, and the second article combines two types of features to improve the identification accuracy to a certain extent. (3) Few sample data with labels, high labor and time cost to build the dataset.
By reading the above literature, we can find that the current identification for blackmail websites can be mainly based on visual features and text features, and there are various classification methods for text and images, and most of the current research is based on a single feature or applying a single method for classification and identification. Inspired by the second literature, we can combine image and text features and combine the current research on text classification and image classification based on deep learning, which has outstanding performance in this field, to improve the accuracy of recognition and classification. Through the third article, we can apply collaborative training algorithm to improve the generalization of the model and optimize the model.

翻译为标准英文。在2009年，Stefan Essar提出了一种针对PHP Web应用程序中的对象注入能力的攻击方法[10, 11]。通过滥用攻击者的能力，借助反序列化过程，任意修改注入到给定Web应用程序中的对象属性，实现魔术方法的逐步调用，进而完成攻击。自Essar提出PHP反序列化问题以来，已出现大量CVE，如CVE-2017-12932，CVE-2017-12933，CVE-2017-12934等。在过去几年里，许多开源PHP内容管理系统（如WordPress，Drupal，Joomla和Piwik）也发现了许多反序列化漏洞。这些漏洞可能导致远程代码执行等严重安全问题，影响大部分Web服务器。反序列化漏洞在过去和最近几年频繁出现（如表所示的七个反序列化漏洞的备案CVE）。

近期出现的PHP反序列化漏洞：

| CVE编号 | 受影响应用 | 参考链接 |
| — | — | — |
| CVE-2020-36326 | PHPMailer | [13] |
| CVE-2019-6339 | Drupal | [14] |
| CVE-2018-20148 | WordPress | - |
| CVE-2018-19296 | PHPMailer | [13] |
| CVE-2018-1000525 | OpenPSA2 | - |
| CVE-2016-8580 | Alienvault | - |
| CVE-2014-2294 | Open Web Analytics | - |

在给定Web应用程序中的数据反序列化过程中，当输入未经过消毒时，种格式使传输复杂数据结构变得容易，并且经常被误用来创建多维cookie和类似数据结构。由于PHP允许对任意对象进行反序列化，攻击者可以将具备任意属性集的专门准备的对象插入应用程序。根据应用程序实现的差异，攻击者可以触发内部PHP魔法函数，这反过来可能导致诸如代码注入、SQL注入、路径遍历和应用程序拒绝服务等漏洞，具体取决于上下文。例如，在CVE-2016-8580中，Alienvault OSSIM和USM存在对象注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者利用漏洞提交特殊请求注入任意对象到应用程序，删除文件，查看文件，执行本地脚本代码。在CVE-2018-20148中，攻击者可以通过特制元数据利用该漏洞实施PHP对象注入攻击，影响WordPress 5.0.1之前的版本，导致远程命令执行。PHPMailer（CVE-2020-36326，CVE-2018-19296）中的PHP反序列化漏洞通过传入可控路径参数到addAttachment函数后，经过is_file触发[13]。CVE-2019-6339使攻击者利用漏洞在Drupal后台执行任意PHP代码[14]。

针对日益增多的PHP反序列化漏洞，越来越多的安全研究人员开始探讨PHP反序列化漏洞的检测。例如，Imperva发布的《黑客智能倡议每月趋势报告》第17期分析了反序列化漏洞CVE-2010-3065[15]。2014年，Dahse等研究者系统化地分析了对象注入漏洞如何通过POP链进行利用，并通过静态扫描检测对象注入漏洞[16]。2014年，J Dahse等人引入了一种自动方法来静态检测面向对象PHP代码中的POI漏洞，并能够以自动方式生成POP链[20]。2018年，陈震杭等人将PHP的敏感函数调用栈作为研究出发点，以Web应用正常运行时的函数调用栈作为判定依据，实现了一个基于PHP敏感函数调用栈的未知反序列化漏洞动态检测与拦截系统[17]。2019年，Koutroumpouchos等人提出ObjectMap工具，用于检测基于Java和PHP的Web应用程序中的反序列化和对象注入功能[18]；但该工具只能检测所传入HTTP数据包中存在漏洞的参数，并不能给出漏洞发生的堆栈信息。2022年，Sunnyeo Park等人结合动、静态分析和模糊测试技术，提出了一种用于挖掘并利用PHP反序列化漏洞的工具——fugio[19]。此外，还有一款基于QL概念搭建的php反序列化链简单模型—phpunserializechain[21]。

翻译为标准英文。根据上述国内外研究分析，目前国内外对反序列化漏洞的研究主要集中在PHP反序列化链的构造和发掘上，对于检测PHP反序列化漏洞点如可控的unserialize函数并未给出全面方案。例如，fugio能够通过静态分析收集所有类和函数信息，以识别所有可用的gadget，经过反馈驱动的模糊处理后，生成利用对象并跟踪已识别链的执行情况，但未给出如何检测发现PHP反序列化漏洞的合适解决方案。对于这方面的研究，主要还是利用静态检测工具，对PHP源码进行分析，通过正则匹配敏感函数规则的方式或者利用AST抽象语法树生成程序模型的方式，来寻找反序列化漏洞点。例如，PHP自动化审计工具seay[7]和RIPS[9]。但由于静态源代码分析的局限性，需要消耗大量计算成本用于应用程序源代码解析，同时漏洞是否真正存在仍需代码审计者确认。因此，漏洞准确率和自动化程度仍有待提高。
结合以上分析，本文基于动态污点分析技术设计了一种自动化检测PHP反序列化漏洞的系统，以PHP扩展的形式快速集成到待检测PHPWeb应用环境中。该系统通过网络爬虫进行爬取触发反序列化敏感函数，快速定位触发反序列化漏洞点，例如unserialize敏感函数的堆栈信息，帮助还原漏洞机理。这种方法可以提高反序列化漏洞检测的效率和准确率，为Web应用的安全提供更加可靠的解决方案。
