Have a look at my implementation and fix if you found any mistakes or any other possible errors which may conflict the outputs of all fours optimization techniques.                                                                                                                                                               def train_model(model, X_train, y_train, X_test, y_test, epochs = None, batch_size = None, learning_rate = None, optimization_technique = None,  patience=None, scheduler_patience=None, **kwargs):
    # Define loss and optimizer
    criterion = nn.BCELoss()
    optimizer = optim.SGD(model.parameters(), lr=learning_rate)
   
    if optimization_technique == 'learning_rate_scheduler' and scheduler_patience:
        scheduler = ReduceLROnPlateau(optimizer, 'min', patience=scheduler_patience, verbose=True)

    # Training segment
    train_losses = []
    train_accuracies = []
    test_losses = []
    test_accuracies = []

    best_loss = float('inf')
    stopping_counter = 0

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        epoch_train_losses = []
        epoch_y_true = []
        epoch_y_pred = []

        for i in range(0, len(X_train), batch_size):
            X_batch = torch.tensor(X_train[i:i + batch_size], dtype=torch.float)
            y_batch = torch.tensor(y_train[i:i + batch_size].values, dtype=torch.float).view(-1, 1)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            y_pred = model(X_batch)
            loss = criterion(y_pred, y_batch)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()

            epoch_train_losses.append(loss.item())
            epoch_y_true.extend(y_batch.numpy().flatten().tolist())
            epoch_y_pred.extend((y_pred > 0.5).float().numpy().flatten().tolist())

        train_losses.append(sum(epoch_train_losses) / len(epoch_train_losses))
        train_accuracies.append(accuracy_score(epoch_y_true, epoch_y_pred))

        # Testing segment
        with torch.no_grad():
            X_test_tensor = torch.tensor(X_test, dtype=torch.float32)
            y_test_tensor = torch.tensor(y_test.values, dtype=torch.float32).view(-1, 1)

            test_pred = model(X_test_tensor)
            test_loss = criterion(test_pred, y_test_tensor)
            test_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test_tensor, (test_pred > 0.5).float())

        test_losses.append(test_loss.item())
        test_accuracies.append(test_accuracy)

        # Early stopping
        if optimization_technique == 'early_stopping' and patience:
            if test_loss < best_loss:
                best_loss = test_loss
                stopping_counter = 0
            else:
                stopping_counter += 1
            if stopping_counter > patience:
                print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}/{epochs}")
                break


        # Learning rate scheduler
        if optimization_technique == 'learning_rate_scheduler' and scheduler_patience and scheduler:
            scheduler.step(test_loss)

        if epoch % 100 == 0:
            print(f"Epoch: {epoch+1}/{epochs}, Training Loss: {train_losses[-1]}, Test Loss: {test_loss.item()}, Training Accuracy: {train_accuracies[-1]}, Test Accuracy: {test_accuracy}")

    return train_losses, train_accuracies, test_losses, test_accuracies




def train_kfold_model(model, X_scaled, y, learning_rate = None, epochs = None, k_splits= None, batch_size= None, patience=None, scheduler_patience=None, **kwargs):
    
    results = []
  
    kfold = KFold(n_splits=k_splits, shuffle=True)

    for train_index, test_index in kfold.split(X_scaled):
        X_train, X_test = X_scaled[train_index], X_scaled[test_index]
        y_train, y_test = y[train_index], y[test_index]

        # Call train_model function
        train_losses, train_accuracies, test_losses, test_accuracies = train_model(model, X_train, y_train, X_test, y_test, epochs, batch_size=batch_size, learning_rate=learning_rate, patience=patience, scheduler_patience=scheduler_patience)
        results.append((train_losses, train_accuracies, test_losses, test_accuracies))

    # Process results as needed
    train_losses, train_accuracies, test_losses, test_accuracies = zip(*results)
    train_losses = [item for sublist in train_losses for item in sublist]
    train_accuracies = [item for sublist in train_accuracies for item in sublist]
    test_losses = [item for sublist in test_losses for item in sublist]
    test_accuracies = [item for sublist in test_accuracies for item in sublist]

    return train_losses, train_accuracies, test_losses, test_accuracies

Background: Lance Du Lac’s parents were the devoted butlers and close friends of the wealthy philanthropist, Alaric Pendragon. Unbeknownst to Lance and Alaric, the Du Lac family lineage traces back to an ancient order of mystical knights known as the Flying Shadows. This secret brotherhood protected the realm using their supernatural powers of flight and super strength. With their order long gone, a hidden temple containing the secrets of the Flying Shadows lay dormant beneath the Pendragon Manor.



Upon accidentally discovering the temple, Lance learns about his ancestral lineage and unlocks his latent mystical powers of increased strength and flight, together with the Sword of the Eclipse. Embracing his newfound abilities, Lance secretly adopts the superhero persona, Black Rose, to protect Alaric and continue his family’s legacy.

7. Communication with Past Selves - As a descendant of the Flying Shadows, Lance has the rare power to communicate with his past selves, accessing their memories, experiences, and wisdom. Geography:
Ravenshadow is nested between the cliffs and the sea, with the coastal areas slowly receding into hilly landscapes further inland. The city itself is sprawling, with a web of cobblestone streets that wind their way through various districts, each with its unique character.

Climate:
Ravenshadow has a temperate, maritime climate that adds to its dark and mysterious atmosphere. Cold, overcast days are the norm here, with frequent fog and drizzle shrouding the city in a cloak of gloom.

Society and Culture:
Although the city is proud of its history, the citizens of Ravenshadow find themselves caught in the crossfire between preservationists and those seeking to modernize the city. This conflict leads to changing dynamics and power struggles between various factions who are vying for influence in Ravenshadow.

Supernatural Elements:

This has lead to the degeneration of their family over time becoming more weak as generations pass. The exhausting ride out of the city had taken its toll on me. Now, I was nearing the manor where I was to reside on Alaric’s orders. The castle seemed architecturally impossible—something that appeared as though it was a force of nature rather than a man-made creation.

As I approached the imposing structure, the car dipped and swayed, finding every hole it could sink into. The sheer magnitude of the manor was staggering, almost making me forget how it had crumbled and continued to crumble with time.

I got out of the car and bid my farewells to the driver. The door opened ominously, giving no indication of anyone being behind it. I stepped into the grand hall, taking in the vast array of furniture and cultural relics, each making an impression on me. That’s when I noticed two ghostly figures drifting through the upper floor.

“Oh, don’t mind them,” a voice spoke apologetically. “They haven’t been themselves recently.”

“It’s no problem, Sir,” I replied. “I’m to blame for entering without knocking.”
“How was your trip ?” The man asked. 
“It was refreshing sir. We city folk don’t get a lot of opportunities to get out of town much so when we do we make a scene out of it.”
The man laughed. “Glad that someone is getting something out of this wasteland. You haven’t visited us since…well since you were a child. Do you find the place to be any different ?” 
“No sir I’m afraid not, It’s the same old mansion that I visited with my parents years ago.” 
“Yes your parents were of good service-shame what happened to them.” 
It was a shame alright, but I know that. I know people want to show their courtesy by offering condolences but sometimes it just reminds of the whole thing all over again. I wish there was something like Christmas cards where you send to people and tell them yes I know you offer your condolences and I’m appreciative of it so please don’t mention it again. But how much annoyed can I be for someone showing their condolences. I was shown into my room. Though at heart I still do believe that these old mansions are all the same, the feeling they can evoke in people are just magnificent. I can imagine an architect who’s excitement for his art cannot be contained as he plans out the mansion. In his mind he will have the chance to create something immortal. Not because a noble families’ name is attached to it but because he had a genuine vision. If anything the mansion is what makes the family. 
I look out the window and I see the days it was being built one of my ancestors helped with its creation it seemed.

Description:
Investing in real estate has always required a capital cushion and access to financing. Category Instructions: Dealership Discussion
The purpose of the category Dealership Discussion is to determine what the caller is discussing with the dealership.


Helpful information:
Connected calls:
Calls must be considered connected to be reviewed in this category. If the call does not qualify as connected, the correction option should be selected to remove the call from the category. A call is considered connected when the caller has either reached the desired agent or reached a qualified agent that can assist the caller.
Qualified agent:
A qualified agent is an employee that can assist a caller with most or all of his or her inquiry. The qualified agent may at times be too busy to handle the inquiry at the time of the call, or he or she may need to gather more information and call back to provide an answer or solution. These scenarios are still considered connected to a qualified agent if the same agent is the one intending to return the call.
Unqualified agent:
An unqualified agent is an employee that is not able to assist the caller with most or all of his or her inquiry either during that specific call or in a promised follow-up call from the same agent.
Interactive systems and auto-attendants:
Calls handled by an interactive system or auto-attendant will sound like interactive recordings that ask questions or request information and require the caller to interact by making phone selections. These can be either Connected or Not Connected.
When a call is successfully handled by an interactive system or auto-attendant it should be considered a connected call, and proper review selections should be made according to the content and outcome of the call.
When a caller leaves a call back number with the interactive system, instead of successfully handling their inquiry or need, then the call should be considered not connected.
Here are the options:
Opportunity to buy/sell/lease/trade a vehicle
Call represented an opportunity for the dealership to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle
The call does not have to include the mention of a particular make or model.
Some opportunities to buy, sell, lease, or trade may at times only mention vehicle specs. These should be listened to carefully to determine if there is an opportunity for the dealership to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle.
All calls that include a caller's interest in buying, selling, leasing, or trading a vehicle should be reviewed with this option, even if the vehicle is not currently available.
Caller inquiries about a vehicle of interest
This may include but is not limited to inquiries about vehicles seen online, in an advertisement, or from driving past the dealership's lot.
Caller expresses general interest in vehicle inventory
This may include but is not limited to inquiries regarding what vehicles are available that fit the caller's price range or what vehicles meet certain desired criteria.
Call is about payment or financing options for the purchase of a vehicle
This does not include calls regarding the financing of a vehicle that is already in the caller's possession.
Caller is inquiring about leasing a vehicle or is interested in a lease buyout
Caller would like to sell or trade a vehicle to the dealership
Caller is another dealership that represents an opportunity to buy or sell a vehicle
This does not include conversations about dealer trades. Dealer trades are not opportunities for a dealership to buy or sell a vehicle. Dealer trades, sometimes also referred to as dealer swaps, are when competing dealerships trade cars with each other, swapping similar cars to meet the demands of their customers. These are exchanges of vehicles only, and they do not represent buying or selling.
Service / parts / collision / body shop
Call is regarding automotive service
This may include but is not limited to service department hour inquiries, general service questions, service needs, service appointments, or inquiring about the status of a vehicle that is already being serviced by the dealership.
Call is regarding automotive parts
This may include but is not limited to parts department hour inquiries, general parts questions, part orders, or price and installation inquiries.
Call is regarding automotive collision or the body shop
This may include but is not limited to collision or body shop department hour inquiries, general collision or body shop questions, price and repair inquiries, and collision or body shop appointments.
General / caller not in market / dealer trade
Caller has general questions or a general conversation that does not represent an opportunity for the buying, selling, or trading of a vehicle
Caller is inquiring about the status of a vehicle order that has already been placed
Caller is inquiring about the delivery of a vehicle they have already purchased
Caller is from a transport company delivering a vehicle or multiple vehicles
Call is about financing and there was no opportunity for the buying, selling, or trading of a vehicle
Call is about the refinancing of a vehicle that is already in the caller's possession
Call is about the payments for a vehicle that is already in the caller's possession
Caller only states that they are coming to the dealership to drop off paperwork, payment, or another item but they do not specify what the drop off is for
Unless a caller specifies that the drop off is regarding an opportunity to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle, or that the drop off is for the service, parts, collision, or body shop departments, then we cannot assume what the drop off is regarding and the call should be considered general.
Call is about the renewal of an existing lease
Call is about the rental of a vehicle or a loaner car
Caller is inquiring about a warranty, tags, or plates
Caller only asks about hours of operation for the business and does not specify a department of service, parts, collision, or body shop
If a caller specifies the sales department, but they only ask about hours of operation for the sales department, it does not represent an opportunity for the buying, selling, or trading of a vehicle and should be considered a general call.
Caller is returning a missed call but the call ends with neither caller nor business identifying the original caller or reason for the call
If a caller's sole inquiry is to identify the reason for a missed call, and they are told by the answering agent that the original caller or reason for the call cannot be identified, this is considered enough information to satisfy the caller's reason for calling. The caller needs no further information, nor needs any further connection to any agent or employee. Thus, the answering agent is qualified, and the call is considered handled.
Caller is returning a missed call but is not in the market to buy, sell, trade, or lease a vehicle
This will often sound like an agent asking a caller if he or she is interested in buying, selling, leasing, or trading in a vehicle, and the caller informing the agent that he or she is not in the market.
Calls should only be considered opportunities when the caller is in the market, regardless of if the agent mentioned a specific vehicle or attempted to encourage the caller to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle. When callers are not in the market, they do not represent business opportunities for the dealership.
Call is regarding a dealer trade
Dealer trades are not opportunities for a dealership to buy or sell a vehicle. Dealer trades, sometimes also referred to as dealer swaps, are when competing dealerships trade cars with each other, swapping similar cars to meet the demands of their customers. These are exchanges of vehicles only, and they do not represent buying or selling.
Caller is from a third-party company asking for information about a vehicle that a mutual customer is interested in
Calls from a third-party company, such as a finance company, may request vehicle information for their own business needs regarding the mutual customer. These third-party companies are not customers, and therefore should not be considered an opportunity to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle.
Caller only refers someone to the dealership but does not themself represent an opportunity for the caller to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle
A referrer alone is not the customer. They are solely attempting to provide the dealership with information about a potential customer. A call should only be considered an opportunity to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle once the actual customer and dealership connect.
Call is an agent-to-agent discussion about a mutual customer but does not represent an opportunity to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle on behalf of the customer
Agent-to-agent discussions, regarding internal business for the dealership, do not themselves represent opportunities.
A call should only be considered an opportunity to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle when the actual customer is the one involved in the discussion with dealership or when the agent involved is speaking on behalf of the customer with the intent to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle.
Correction: caller never connected to a live, qualified agent
Call was not handled by a live, qualified employee/agent.
You can reference the instructions for the upstream category Inbound if you need assistance in understanding what qualifies as a call that is handled by a live, qualified employee/agent

This will often sound like an agent asking a caller if he or she is interested in buying, selling, leasing, or trading in a vehicle, and the caller informing the agent that he or she is not in the market.
Calls should only be considered opportunities when the caller is in the market, regardless of if the agent mentioned a specific vehicle or attempted to encourage the caller to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle. When callers are not in the market, they do not represent business opportunities for the dealership.
Call is regarding a dealer trade
Dealer trades are not opportunities for a dealership to buy or sell a vehicle. Dealer trades, sometimes also referred to as dealer swaps, are when competing dealerships trade cars with each other, swapping similar cars to meet the demands of their customers. These are exchanges of vehicles only, and they do not represent buying or selling.
Caller is from a third-party company asking for information about a vehicle that a mutual customer is interested in
Calls from a third-party company, such as a finance company, may request vehicle information for their own business needs regarding the mutual customer. These third-party companies are not customers, and therefore should not be considered an opportunity to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle.
Caller only refers someone to the dealership but does not themself represent an opportunity for the caller to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle
A referrer alone is not the customer. They are solely attempting to provide the dealership with information about a potential customer. A call should only be considered an opportunity to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle once the actual customer and dealership connect.
Call is an agent-to-agent discussion about a mutual customer but does not represent an opportunity to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle on behalf of the customer
Agent-to-agent discussions, regarding internal business for the dealership, do not themselves represent opportunities.
A call should only be considered an opportunity to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle when the actual customer is the one involved in the discussion with dealership or when the agent involved is speaking on behalf of the customer with the intent to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle.
Correction: caller never connected to a live, qualified agent
Call was not handled by a live, qualified employee/agent.
You can reference the instructions for the upstream category Inbound if you need assistance in understanding what qualifies as a call that is handled by a live, qualified employee/agent

The purpose of the category Dealership Discussion is to determine what the caller is discussing with the dealership.


Helpful information:
Connected calls:
Calls must be considered connected to be reviewed in this category. If the call does not qualify as connected, the correction option should be selected to remove the call from the category. A call is considered connected when the caller has either reached the desired agent or reached a qualified agent that can assist the caller.
Qualified agent:
A qualified agent is an employee that can assist a caller with most or all of his or her inquiry. The qualified agent may at times be too busy to handle the inquiry at the time of the call, or he or she may need to gather more information and call back to provide an answer or solution. These scenarios are still considered connected to a qualified agent if the same agent is the one intending to return the call.
Unqualified agent:
An unqualified agent is an employee that is not able to assist the caller with most or all of his or her inquiry either during that specific call or in a promised follow-up call from the same agent.
Interactive systems and auto-attendants:
Calls handled by an interactive system or auto-attendant will sound like interactive recordings that ask questions or request information and require the caller to interact by making phone selections. These can be either Connected or Not Connected.
When a call is successfully handled by an interactive system or auto-attendant it should be considered a connected call, and proper review selections should be made according to the content and outcome of the call.
When a caller leaves a call back number with the interactive system, instead of successfully handling their inquiry or need, then the call should be considered not connected.
Here are the options:
Opportunity to buy/sell/lease/trade a vehicle
Call represented an opportunity for the dealership to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle
The call does not have to include the mention of a particular make or model.
Some opportunities to buy, sell, lease, or trade may at times only mention vehicle specs. These should be listened to carefully to determine if there is an opportunity for the dealership to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle.
All calls that include a caller's interest in buying, selling, leasing, or trading a vehicle should be reviewed with this option, even if the vehicle is not currently available.
Caller inquiries about a vehicle of interest
This may include but is not limited to inquiries about vehicles seen online, in an advertisement, or from driving past the dealership's lot.
Caller expresses general interest in vehicle inventory
This may include but is not limited to inquiries regarding what vehicles are available that fit the caller's price range or what vehicles meet certain desired criteria.
Call is about payment or financing options for the purchase of a vehicle
This does not include calls regarding the financing of a vehicle that is already in the caller's possession.
Caller is inquiring about leasing a vehicle or is interested in a lease buyout
Caller would like to sell or trade a vehicle to the dealership
Caller is another dealership that represents an opportunity to buy or sell a vehicle
This does not include conversations about dealer trades. Dealer trades are not opportunities for a dealership to buy or sell a vehicle. Dealer trades, sometimes also referred to as dealer swaps, are when competing dealerships trade cars with each other, swapping similar cars to meet the demands of their customers. These are exchanges of vehicles only, and they do not represent buying or selling.
Service / parts / collision / body shop
Call is regarding automotive service
This may include but is not limited to service department hour inquiries, general service questions, service needs, service appointments, or inquiring about the status of a vehicle that is already being serviced by the dealership.
Call is regarding automotive parts
This may include but is not limited to parts department hour inquiries, general parts questions, part orders, or price and installation inquiries.
Call is regarding automotive collision or the body shop
This may include but is not limited to collision or body shop department hour inquiries, general collision or body shop questions, price and repair inquiries, and collision or body shop appointments.
General / caller not in market / dealer trade
Caller has general questions or a general conversation that does not represent an opportunity for the buying, selling, or trading of a vehicle
Caller is inquiring about the status of a vehicle order that has already been placed
Caller is inquiring about the delivery of a vehicle they have already purchased
Caller is from a transport company delivering a vehicle or multiple vehicles
Call is about financing and there was no opportunity for the buying, selling, or trading of a vehicle
Call is about the refinancing of a vehicle that is already in the caller's possession
Call is about the payments for a vehicle that is already in the caller's possession
Caller only states that they are coming to the dealership to drop off paperwork, payment, or another item but they do not specify what the drop off is for
Unless a caller specifies that the drop off is regarding an opportunity to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle, or that the drop off is for the service, parts, collision, or body shop departments, then we cannot assume what the drop off is regarding and the call should be considered general.
Call is about the renewal of an existing lease
Call is about the rental of a vehicle or a loaner car
Caller is inquiring about a warranty, tags, or plates
Caller only asks about hours of operation for the business and does not specify a department of service, parts, collision, or body shop
If a caller specifies the sales department, but they only ask about hours of operation for the sales department, it does not represent an opportunity for the buying, selling, or trading of a vehicle and should be considered a general call.
Caller is returning a missed call but the call ends with neither caller nor business identifying the original caller or reason for the call
If a caller's sole inquiry is to identify the reason for a missed call, and they are told by the answering agent that the original caller or reason for the call cannot be identified, this is considered enough information to satisfy the caller's reason for calling. The caller needs no further information, nor needs any further connection to any agent or employee. Thus, the answering agent is qualified, and the call is considered handled.
Caller is returning a missed call but is not in the market to buy, sell, trade, or lease a vehicle
This will often sound like an agent asking a caller if he or she is interested in buying, selling, leasing, or trading in a vehicle, and the caller informing the agent that he or she is not in the market.
Calls should only be considered opportunities when the caller is in the market, regardless of if the agent mentioned a specific vehicle or attempted to encourage the caller to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle. When callers are not in the market, they do not represent business opportunities for the dealership.
Call is regarding a dealer trade
Dealer trades are not opportunities for a dealership to buy or sell a vehicle. Dealer trades, sometimes also referred to as dealer swaps, are when competing dealerships trade cars with each other, swapping similar cars to meet the demands of their customers. These are exchanges of vehicles only, and they do not represent buying or selling.
Caller is from a third-party company asking for information about a vehicle that a mutual customer is interested in
Calls from a third-party company, such as a finance company, may request vehicle information for their own business needs regarding the mutual customer. These third-party companies are not customers, and therefore should not be considered an opportunity to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle.
Caller only refers someone to the dealership but does not themself represent an opportunity for the caller to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle
A referrer alone is not the customer. They are solely attempting to provide the dealership with information about a potential customer. A call should only be considered an opportunity to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle once the actual customer and dealership connect.
Call is an agent-to-agent discussion about a mutual customer but does not represent an opportunity to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle on behalf of the customer
Agent-to-agent discussions, regarding internal business for the dealership, do not themselves represent opportunities.
A call should only be considered an opportunity to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle when the actual customer is the one involved in the discussion with dealership or when the agent involved is speaking on behalf of the customer with the intent to buy, sell, lease, or trade a vehicle.

МКК работает в партнерстве с Вестминстерским университетом, давно зарекомендовавшим себя учебным заведением, расположенным в самом центре Лондона. Больше информации о Вестминстерском университете Вы можете найти на страницах 4-5.

Успех в карьере

schreibe folgenden text um: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart wurde am 27.01.1756 in der Stadt Salzburg geboren. Er und seine Familie wohnten dort in einem kleinen Haus in der Getreidegasse.
Mozart hatte noch eine Schwester sie hieß: Maria Anna genannt Nannerl.
Der Vater Leopold spielte Violine im Orchester des Salzburger Fürstbischofes und gab Klavierunterricht. So auch Wolfgangs Schwester Maria. Der kleine Mozart saß immer dabei und hörte gespannt zu. So hörte er die Töne des Klaviers und lernte nur durch Zuhören dieses Instrument. Der Vater schenkte seinen Kindern ein Notenbuch, welches er selbst komponiert hatte. Nannerl war zu diesem Zeitpunkt 8 Jahre alt und Wolfgang noch unter fünf Jahren. Die Nannerl übte fleißig und der kleine Mozart hörte einfach nur zu. Danach setzte er sich ans Cembalo und spielte das Stück ganz ohne Noten fehlerfrei. Das kleine Wunder sprach sich in der Stadt schnell herum. Er musste Konzerte geben.
Als der Junge 6 Jahre alt war (1762), wurde er zum Kaiser und zu seiner Gemahlin gebeten um dort ein Konzert zu geben. Wolfgang und seine Schwester traten auf und zeigten ihr Talent. Der Kaiser und die Kaiserin waren begeistert!
Die Mozarts hatten sogar vor, nach Paris und London zu reisen.
Als Mozart Junior 7 Jahre alt war ging es hinaus aus der Stadt Salzburg. Auf dem Weg nach Paris machten sie einige Stationen z.B. in München, Dort spielte er auf Schloss Nymphenburg und in Augsburg wo die Familie des Vaters lebte.
Von dort aus ging es nach Ludwigsburg auf das Schloss des Herzogs. Dieser hatte aber keine Zeit für sie. Dann ging es nach Schwetzingen, wo es um so schöner war. Das war im Jahre 1763. Dann ging es nach Frankfurt wo er vor dem jungen Goethe spielte und nach Aachen das war der teuerste Ort den die Mozarts je gesehen haben und von dort nach Brüssel. Von dort aus war es nicht mehr weit nach Paris. In Paris wurden sie nach Versailles zum König zu einem Festessen eingeladen. Die Kinder gaben ein Konzert und der französische König war begeistert. Wolfgang war gerade erst 7 Jahre alt.
Von Paris ging es nach London (1764), wo sie schon nach vier Tagen zum König gebeten wurden. Die Kinder gaben auch dort ein Konzert. Drei Wochen später war der Geburtstag des Königs. Die Mozarts stiegen in London auf ein Schiff und fuhren zu einer großen runden Halle. Dort setzte sich der junge Mozart an das Cembalo und leitete ein ganzes Orchester von Erwachsenen. Sieben Monate blieb Mozart in London. Aber dann wurde der Vater schwer krank und die Familie zog sich auf einen Landsitz zurück. Die Krankheit dauerte 9 Monate (?), in denen keine Klaviertaste angeschlagen werden durfte. Diese Zeit nutzte der Wolfgang zum Komponieren. Sie konnten in der Zeit auch nicht auftreten. Durch diese lange Krankheit blieben sie ein über ein Jahr in London. Dann stiegen sie in London in ein Segelschiff und fuhren nach Frankreich und von dort nach Den Haag. Dort spielten sie auf Schloss Oranien. Die beiden Kinder erkrankten an Lungenentzündung wurden aber wieder gesund. Das war im Jahre 1765.
Im Jahre 1766 kehrten sie zurück nach Salzburg. Das war keine leichte Kindheit für Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart.
Dieser wurde 1769 in den Dienst des Salzburger Fürstbischoffes gestellt, da war er 13 Jahre alt. Mit 15 hatte er seine erste bezahlte Arbeit.
1782 heiratete er Constanze Weber und hatte 5 Kinder mit ihr. Berühmte Werke von Mozart sind z.B. die Zauberflöte, Figaros Hochzeit, Posthornserenade, Haffner Symphonie, Linzer Symphonie. Seine Werke wurden in einem Verzeichnis chronologisch geordnet. Dieses Verzeichnis heißt Köchelverzeichnis kurz KV. Er schrieb Konzerte für: Klavier, Violine, Oboe, Klarinette, Fagott, Harfe, Querflöte und Horn. Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart verbrachte sein letztes Lebensjahr (1791) in Wien. Er wurde nur 35 Jahre alt.
Timo Schubert Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart

罗素对德国的哲学传统理解的很轻佻，这与他的贵族身份不无关系。他认为马克思有两点错误：第一，必须加以考虑的社会情况有经济一面，同样也有政治一面；这些情况同权力有关，而财富只是权力的一个形式。第二，问题只要一成为细节上的和专门性的，社会因果关系大多不再适用。这两点反对意见中头一点，我在我写的《权力》（Power）一书中已经讲过了，所以我不准备再谈。第二点和哲学史有比较密切的关系，我打算就它的范围举一些实例。
由此可以看出，在罗素的观念里面政治（权利）、社会、经济（生产），是联系的、但可以分开的三个部分。他以此来批判马克思对政治和社会的忽视，而只关注生产。事实上，在马克思的哲学里面，社会是经济关系的凝结、政治是社会关系的凝结，三者的有区别但不可分。分配与权力有关，事实上就是生产上阶级的对立的政治表现。由此而言，不得不说他对马克思的理解与他的贵族身份不无关系。
“把马克思纯粹当一个哲学家来看，他有严重的缺点。他过于尚实际，过分全神贯注在他那个时代的问题上。他的眼界局限于我们的这个星球，在这个星球范围之内，又局限于人类。自从哥白尼以来已经很显然，人类并没有从前人类自许的那种宇宙重要地位。凡是没彻底领会这个事实的人，谁也无资格把自己的哲学称作科学的哲学。”
这一段更是让人哭笑不得的评论。人不是宇宙的中心，这不假。但人作为哲学的中心，并不能作为一种错误，这是西方哲学的传统。自然哲学的研究对象不是人，但自然哲学是哲学基础上的一个分支，即以人为中心基础上的客体为研究对象。宇宙是一种客观存在，但若没有人，也就不存在人的“客观存在”的这种感知。
罗素对卢梭更为认同，即他认为社会在政治、社会、经济的三分体中更重要，或者说，他认为是社会是政治和经济的基础。这一点与马克思的理论根本不同。虽然，他十分推崇马克思的唯物论，并把哲学家与其生活的社会联系在一起研究哲学史的思维方式，归结为受马克思的影响，但他依然是个唯心主义者。

from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

def train_model(model, X_train, y_train, X_test, y_test, epochs = None, batch_size = None, learning_rate = None, optimization_technique = None,  patience=None, scheduler_patience=None, **kwargs):
    # Define loss and optimizer
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
    optimizer = optim.SGD(model.parameters(), lr=learning_rate)

    if optimization_technique == 'learning_rate_scheduler' and scheduler_patience:
        scheduler = ReduceLROnPlateau(optimizer, 'min', patience=scheduler_patience, verbose=True)

    # Training segment
    train_losses = []
    train_accuracies = []
    test_losses = []
    test_accuracies = []

    best_loss = float('inf')
    stopping_counter = 0

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        epoch_train_losses = []
        epoch_y_true = []
        epoch_y_pred = []

        for i in range(0, len(X_train), batch_size):
            X_batch = torch.tensor(X_train[i:i + batch_size], dtype=torch.float).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
            y_batch = torch.tensor(y_train[i:i + batch_size].values, dtype=torch.long).view(-1)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            y_pred = model(X_batch)
            loss = criterion(y_pred, y_batch)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()

            epoch_train_losses.append(loss.item())
            epoch_y_true.extend(y_batch.numpy().flatten().tolist())
            epoch_y_pred.extend(y_pred.argmax(dim=1).numpy().flatten().tolist())

        train_losses.append(sum(epoch_train_losses) / len(epoch_train_losses))
        train_accuracies.append(accuracy_score(epoch_y_true, epoch_y_pred))

        # Testing segment
        with torch.no_grad():
            X_test_tensor = torch.tensor(X_test, dtype=torch.float32).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
            y_test_tensor = torch.tensor(y_test.values, dtype=torch.long).view(-1)

            test_pred = model(X_test_tensor)
            _, preds_indices = torch.max(test_pred, 1)
            test_loss = criterion(test_pred, y_test_tensor)
            test_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test_tensor, preds_indices)

        test_losses.append(test_loss.item())
        test_accuracies.append(test_accuracy)

        # Early stopping
        if optimization_technique == 'early_stopping' and patience:
            if test_loss < best_loss:
                best_loss = test_loss
                stopping_counter = 0
            else:
                stopping_counter += 1
            if stopping_counter > patience:
                print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}/{epochs}")
                break

        # Learning rate scheduler
        if optimization_technique == 'learning_rate_scheduler' and scheduler_patience and scheduler:
            scheduler.step(test_loss)

        if epoch % 100 == 0:
            print(f"Epoch: {epoch+1}/{epochs}, Training Loss: {train_losses[-1]}, Test Loss: {test_loss.item()}, Training Accuracy: {train_accuracies[-1]}, Test Accuracy: {test_accuracy}")

    return train_losses, train_accuracies, test_losses, test_accuracies

log_gamma <- function(n) { #converted to log scale since numbers so big
  log(factorial(n-1))
}

#log beta function
log_beta_func <- function(a, b) {
  log_gamma(a) + log_gamma(b) - log_gamma(a+b)
}

#beta density values
beta_d <- function(x, a, b) {
  exp((a-1) * log(x) + (b-1) * log(1-x) - log_beta_func(a,b))
}

#minus log likelihood for beta distribution
minus_log_likelihood <- function(par, data) {
  alpha <- par[1] 
  beta <- par[2]
  -sum(log(beta_d(data, alpha, beta)))
}

#First derivative of the log likelihood

	alpha <- par[1]
	beta <- par[2]
	dalpha <- sum(1/beta(alpha, beta) * (log(data) + (alpha-1)/data - (beta-1)/(1-data)))
  dbeta <- sum(1/ beta(alpha, beta) * ((alpha-1)/data - (beta-1)/(1-data)))
  
	matrix(c(dalpha,

}



#Second derivative of the log likelihood
ll_hessian <- function(par, data) {
	alpha <- par[1]
	beta <- par[2]
  b <- beta(alpha, beta)
  dalpha2 <- -sum(1/b * (log(data) + (beta-1)/(1-data) - alpha/data)^2 - 1/b/data^2)

  H

Dim cell As Range
For Each cell In rng
If Not IsEmpty(cell) Then
If IsNumeric(cell.Value) Then
IsNumberColumn = True
Else
IsNumberColumn = False
End If
Exit For
End If
Next cell
End Function

Other studies assessing the accuracy of estimated portion sizes have used photographs as the reference for the assessment (Huybregts et al, 2007, Turconi et al, 2005), fake food items (Bucher et al, 2011, Bucher et al, 2012, Bucher et al, 2013) or average portion size weights based on repeated measures (Ngigi, Verbeke, & Pérez-Cueto, 2011). In contrast, the present study was performed using actual food items. In addition, the use of the Intelligent Buffet allowed the exact weight of food served by each participant to be recorded in a relatively undisturbed manner.

There are a few potential sources of bias in this study, one being measurement bias. An attempt was made to limit this by calibrating the equipment used for data collection before use and by following standard laboratory procedures. Therefore, if any measurement bias were to occur, it would be systematic throughout all observations. Secondly, the sample size may have been insufficient. However, the calculated power of 0.99 for the observed mean differences of both vegetables and whole grains suggests that the sample was enough to support the rejection of the null hypothesis. Previous studies have used a similar sample size with sufficient power (Mekhmoukh, Chapelot, & Bellisle, 2012). Thus, we assume that the result of the Wilcoxon signed-rank test was accurate (absence of type II error), and that it was correct to reject the null hypothesis since there was a significant difference between the two variables – the estimated and actual amount of food served.

Our findings are in agreement with similar studies conducted in a number of different countries and settings, including Norway (Uglem et al., 2008), the Netherlands (Lechner et al., 1997), Australia (Pollard et al., 2008) and Denmark (Sørensen et al., 2013), suggesting that individuals commonly have difficulties estimating food portion sizes with accuracy. The findings of a statistically significant difference between participants’ self-estimation and the actual weight of the vegetables served led to the rejection of the null hypothesis (Table 1). The participants in this study were also asked to estimate the weight of a whole grain serving in a relatively complex meal. It would be of interest to determine whether the results would have been more accurate if a simpler meal had been served (e.g. a bowl of cereal). However, the everyday diet commonly consists of prepared meals or ready-to-eat foods and individuals are often not aware of the actual composition of the foods they consume. Therefore, serving a “complex meal” is comparable with a real life situation, where participants are expected to estimate the amount of food served (Combet et al, 2013, Loh et al, 2013).

This study presents the question of whether food intake estimations that are independent of actual weighing are valid, particularly in the evaluation of adherence to healthy eating recommendations (Pérez-Cueto et al., 2012). This also underscores the importance of using alternative equipment and techniques, such as an Intelligent Buffet, in order to obtain actual data in studies measuring factors such as food intake (Bucher et al., 2012). The Intelligent Buffet presents many opportunities to conduct other studies or further research on this particular topic. In combination with video cameras, this equipment could be used for choice architectural experiments researching behaviour related to a buffet setting. For example, it could be used to investigate whether individual consumption differs in relation to the order of food items or the size of serving trays.

Ученые в течение 4,5 лет наблюдали за почти 20 тысячами здоровых (это важно) пожилых людей (средний возраст — 75 лет). Они периодически измеряли их вес и окружность талии, а также регистрировали причины смертей — учитывая возраст участников, их было немало. И оказалось, что среди женщин и особенно мужчин, которые потеряли более 5-10% веса, смертность от всех причин была существенно выше, чем среди участников, которые похудели не так сильно, не похудели или даже набрали вес.

Кажется, что все очевидно: начали худеть, лишили организм энергии, «ослабили иммунную систему» (о, как я обожаю эту формулировку) — ну и вот. И разумеется, это неверный вывод. Участники эксперимента не худели специально — как минимум массово. Худеющие теряли вес без приложения намеренных усилий: как пишут авторы, у них пропадал аппетит, они начинали меньше есть и, соответственно, худели. А потом умирали.

Когда здоровый человек неожиданно и без видимых причин худеет, врачи начинают беспокоиться и искать причину. Нередко ею оказывается, например, рак: потеря веса — один из типичных неспецифических его симптомов. В этой работе рак тоже входил в число причин смерти внезапно похудевших добровольцев. То есть наиболее логичное объяснение выявленной зависимости между снижением веса и повышенной смертностью: у этих людей начал активно развиваться тот или иной патологический процесс и/или болезнь — и потеря веса была одним из ранних симптомов. В этой ситуации плюсы для здоровья от снижения веса не играют роли, так как имеет место процесс, несущий для него колоссальные минусы. И собственно похудение является следствием этого процесса.

Соответственно, вывод этого исследования не в том, что намеренно сбрасывать вес вредно, а в том, что необъяснимая потеря 5-10% веса особенно в пожилом возрасте должна насторожить врачей. Потому что она может указывать на развитие серьезных патологий, причем это может быть не только рак. Собственно, ничего нового в этом наблюдении нет, но в свете поляризации отношения к весу даже, казалось бы, очевидные вещи намеренно или по незнанию часто трактуют неверно.

Hi! Now I will describe to you my sketch of the structure of the world through a fictional legend of representatives of this world. The legend is called MHIWYA. After the legend, I will ask you a few questions about how to complement it and the world of people who could invent it.

The text of the legend MHIWYA: Once The Supreme-God-Demiurge created the world — the World-of-the-Children-of-God — from several dimensions, and each of the dimensions was inhabited by The Children of God. Nature, weather and conditions on the planet are similar to those on Earth (so far, I think so)

A full-fledged connection between dimensions would be impossible if there were not two ways to implement it:

Way 1: Carriers. A social class of The Children of God who can take the forms of birds and have the ability to Transcale: instant adaptation to any dimension in which the Carrier may be. Carriers are able to give this ability to their passengers at the time of joint travel.

Way 2: Engineers' Devices. Engineers are another social class of The Children of God, capable of producing special electronic devices that allow simulating the external senses of representatives of different dimensions, so that the connection between them, even at a distance in time and space, is fast and complete in terms of the coincidence of the organs of perception of all participants in the act of communication.

One of the Carriers was the eagle Altair: a storyteller whose voice and stories fascinated. He had a special instrument, let's temporarily call it the Altair Lyre, a six-stringed elegant lyre with a body resembling a swirling sea wave. At night, retreating into the rocks, Altair took on a form that allowed him to play an instrument. During the day, being a Carrier, Altair did not accompany his voice in any way, and his sweet speech was everything that should have delighted enthusiastic passengers.

One day, a young Daughter of God Vega came to the Carrier and asked to take her several dimensions ahead. She had never felt those places before, and she wanted to find out how it was possible to learn with the help of a completely different understanding of the world, as she thought, more complete and unusual.

Vega and Altair started talking. They were concerned that since the time when their world was created (the faith of The Children of God in The Supreme-God-Demiurge was unshakable and there were several artifacts confirming its existence), no one talks about whether other worlds similar to theirs were created. And is it possible for simple Child of God to become like The Supreme-God-Demiurge? Can Vega or Altair achieve such perfection in their art that they can create worlds themselves? Once Altair heard from one of the passengers that it was possible to combine the attributes of several social classes so that the result would be “something inexpressible". For example, an element for a combination could be Altair's Lyre or his fairy tales. And Vega's…

Vega continued the craft of the Weavers' class: The Weavers planned the trajectories of the Carriers. One of her tools were Needles — they marked points in the multidimensional space of their world that Carriers had to pass through to activate their abilities and reach the right tools. Accordingly, the attributes of Vega for the necessary combination that could lead to the creation of a new world could be Needles.

Altair and Vega spent a lot of time together: Vega often traveled, and Altair seemed to inevitably, by fate itself, find himself on her way. Vega listened attentively to all his fairy tales and once admitted that she would like to hear them at night: at a time when Altair was changing his external form and playing the Lyre. Altair agreed, and from then on, once every few weeks or months, they spent a Night of Songs together. Vega brought Needles to these meetings and, instead of plotting the trajectories of future interdimensional movements with them, she clung to Altair's words, the overtones of his voice, and connected them to the place where they were. Now, with the help of Needles, pebbles, leaves of rare shrubs, sand and even fog seemed to enter into a dialogue with Altair. Vega felt almost like an Engineer: what if she and Altair could create a new world? It seems that they already have almost everything for this…

One day Altair received a special task and realized that he had to leave the dimension where Vega lived for a long time. They met again at the moment when Vega decided to go on one of her interdimensional journeys, and Altair told her the sad news: “Perhaps we will never feel each other with you again, only if the Engineers don't come to the rescue ... but now I can't tell you where to look for me, and how to contact me.” Vega was stunned, but tried to restrain herself. At parting, Altair presented her with a great gift: “without you, I don't see the point of singing. Take this Lyre and, if destined, create a new world alone.”

Vega accepted Altair's Lyre as a gift. She saw Altair off and returned home, looking at the Needles with hatred: “Am I really going to be forced to help lay routes for the rest of my days, on which we will never cross again?”

Vega plunged into the study of the art of pairing attributes — alchemy. In the end, she succeeded: by putting together the music of Altair's Lyre, Altair's songs, which Vega performed herself from now on, and what she turned into Needles, turning to Engineers for help — a toy car for transporting passengers moving along the rails (The Train) — Vega got a completely new living space. The movement of the Train for transportation, which Vega named after her attributes — the Needle, under her songs, created a special field around itself, which turned into the atmosphere of a new small planet — MHIWYA (it was in honor of her that I gave the name to the whole legend). on this planet, as Vega learns later, the seed of future life was also born.

The first people who appeared on MHIWYA were called Nomads or Voices, which is a more general term. Each of Nomads had a voice of fabulous beauty and depth, the ranges of which coincided with the ranges of the six strings of the Altair Lyre. From now on, the tales and songs of the Nomads will maintain the state of MHIWYA from the inside, while Vega continues her Eternal Divine Song of abandonment and loneliness from the outside. The nomads founded the City, and everyone they spawned became Citizens. Also, every Citizen was a Voice along the branch of the Nomad he was born with.

MHIWYA, as well as the World-of-the-Children-of-God, turned out to be multidimensional, but now communication between residents of different dimensions was carried out with the help of an Needle Train, transporting people to each other along looped rails that permeate the entire new planet.     start_date = (datetime.now() - timedelta(days=99)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')

        for idx, future in enumerate(futures, start=1):
            result += f"API Key {idx}:\n"
            try:
                key_result, glitched, has_gpt_4 = future.result()
                result += key_result
                if glitched:
                    glitched_keys.append(api_keys[idx - 1])
                if has_gpt_4:
                    gpt_4_keys.append(api_keys[idx - 1])
            except Exception as e:
                result += f"  This key is invalid or revoked\n"
            result += '\n'

    result += f"\nNumber of API keys with 'gpt-4' model: {len(gpt_4_keys)}\n"
    for key in gpt_4_keys:
        result += f"  - {key}\n"

    result += f"\nNumber of possibly glitched API keys: {len(glitched_keys)}\n"
    for key in glitched_keys:
        result += f"  - {key}\n"

    return result

        time.sleep(0.1)
        sys.stdout.write("\rProcessing... /")
        time.sleep(0.1)
        sys.stdout.write("\rProcessing... -")
        time.sleep(0.1)
        sys.stdout.write("\rProcessing... \\")
        time.sleep(0.1)
    sys.stdout.write("\rDone!          \n")

Vega and Altair started talking. And is it possible for simple Child of God to become like The Supreme-God-Demiurge? Can Vega or Altair achieve such perfection in their art that they can create worlds themselves? For example, an element for a combination could be Altair's Lyre or his fairy tales. And Vega's…

Vega continued the craft of the Weavers' class: The Weavers planned the trajectories of the Carriers. MHIWYA, as well as the World-of-the-Children-of-God, turned out to be multidimensional, but now communication between residents of different dimensions was carried out with the help of an Needle Train, transporting people to each other along looped rails that permeate the entire new planet.             nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(384, 384, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(384, 256, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2),
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5),
            nn.Linear(256 * 6 * 6, 4096),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5),
            nn.Linear(4096, 4096),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Linear(4096, len(folder_names)),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.features(x)
        x = x.view(x.size(0), 256 * 6 * 6)
        x = self.classifier(x)
        return x


class ImageDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, folder_names, transform=None):
        self.folder_names = folder_names
        self.transform = transform
        
    def __len__(self):
        return sum(len(os.listdir(folder)) for folder in self.folder_names)
    
    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        for i, folder_name in enumerate(self.folder_names):
            if idx < len(os.listdir(folder_name)):
                file = os.listdir(folder_name)[idx]
                img = Image.open(os.path.join(folder_name, file))
                if self.transform:
                    img = self.transform(img)
                label = i
                return img, label
            idx -= len(os.listdir(folder_name))

        num_batches_train = 0

        test_accuracies.append(running_test_acc / num_batches_test)

    return train_losses, train_accuracies, test_losses, test_accuracies

Задатак – Ајнштајнове загонетке [100 поена]
Ајнштајнова загонетка представља логички проблем, где одређене појмове треба упарити по
задатим правилима. Појмови су задати у неколико група (свака група има исти број појмова)
и сваки појам из једне групе треба да буде упарен са по тачно једним појмом из осталих група,
и то тако да буду испуњени сви унапред задати односи између појединачних појмова.
Оригинална Ајнштајнова загонетка може се видети на линку
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zebra_Puzzle. У оригиналној верзији загонетке се посматрају и
међусобне позиције појмова (уређеност је битна), али ће се у оквиру овог домаћег задатка
решавати једноставнија верзија.
Пример: Постоје три групе са по три појма - три особе (Маја, Матија, Сања), три боје (плава,
жута, зелена) и три објекта (телефон, рачунар, свеска). Нека су задати следећи односи између
појмова:
● Маја воли жуту боју.
● Матија не користи свеску.
● Сања не воли зелену боју.
● Маја не користи свеску.
● Особа која воли зелену боју не користи свеску.
● Маја не користи рачунар.
На основу ових правила се могу упарити сви појмови: Маја воли жуту боју; Сања воли плаву
боју (Маја је већ упарена са жутом бојом, а зна се да Сања не треба да буде упарена са зеленом
⇒ Сања се упарује са плавом бојом) и Матија воли зелену боју (једина преостала); Маја не
користи ни свеску, ни рачунар ⇒ Маја користи телефон; Матија не користи свеску, а ни
телефон (јер га користи Маја) ⇒ Матија користи рачунар; преостаје да Сања користи свеску.
Приметимо да однос „Особа која воли зелену боју не користи свеску“ није коришћен у овом
резоновању, али свакако је испуњен у упаривању (Матија је особа која воли зелену боју и он
не користи свеску).
Маја Матија Сања
жута зелена плава
телефон рачунар свеска
Табела 1. Решење загонетке
Могуће је да загонетка нема решење – да је однос између појмова гласио „Особа која воли
зелену боју користи свеску“, ови појмови не би могли бити упарени (Матија не користи
свеску, а воли зелену боју). Такође је могуће да загонетка има више решења – да иницијално
није задат однос „Маја не користи рачунар“, загонетка би имала два валидна решења (знамо

Матија да користи телефон, а Маја рачунар).
Потребно је имплементирати решавање загонетки применом стабала одлучивања.
[15 поена] Учитавање игре
Једна игра се започиње учитавањем са стандардног улаза или учитавањем одговарајућег
текстуалног фајла следећег формата:
● У првом реду се задаје број група појмова (М).
● У другом реду се задаје број појмова (N) у једној групи.
● У наредних М редова се налазе N појмова те групе, одвојени зарезом.
● У преосталим редовима фајла се налазе односи између појмова по следећем формату -

зелена - свеска)

На основу учитаних појмова и односа треба формирати стабло одлучивања [20 поена]. Све

да је прва група појмова „фиксирана“ и да појмове из прве групе треба упарити са осталима
(табела 2). Један чвор стабла представља стање у којем су појмови делимично или потпуно
упарени на неки начин (корак игре). Део могућег стабла за горенаведени пример дат је на

[55 поена] Обраде над формираним стаблом
Након формирања стабла, програм треба да омогући кориснику следеће обраде:
а) [20 поена] Испис стабла
Омогућити испис изгледа формираног стабла (погодно форматиран, по нивоима).
У зависности од редног броја проблема који се решава i, потребно је реализовати решење

1. Preorder обилазак стабла
2. Level-order обилазак стабла
б) [10 поена] Испис свих решења стабла
Коришћењем задатог обиласка исписати по корацима решење загонетке (ниједног,
једног или више, уколико их има).
в) [25 поена] Корисник решава игру
Омогућити кориснику да уноси упаривање појмова и на тај начин игра игру. Кориснику
у сваком тренутку треба омогућити да може да провери да ли је до сада исправно упарио
појмове (по задатим односима), да ли је „на добром путу“, тј. да ли га тренутно стање

воде ка решењу загонетке), може да каже да нема решења или да одустане (крај игре).
Корисник са програмом интерагује путем једноставног менија. Програм треба да испише
садржај менија, а затим да чека да корисник изабере (унесе путем тастатуре) редни број неке
од понуђених ставки, након чега, пре извршења, од корисника очекује да по потреби унесе

LA NUTRIZIONE UMANA. Per crescere e moltiplicarsi, ma anche solo per mantenersi, l’organismo umano, come tutti gli

le sue cellule, energia sia per effettuare queste sintesi, sia per compiere gli altri tipi di lavoro
che i diversi organi e tessuti sono chiamati a svolgere. L’uomo è un organismo eterotrofo:
non è infatti capace di trasformare composti inorganici in composti organici, ma deve prelevare
dall’ambiente composti organici già sintetizzati da altri organismi, da cui trarre il materiale per
sintetizzare i propri componenti. L’uomo è anche un organismo chemiotrofo: i composti organici
prelevati dall’ambiente costituiscono infatti anche la fonte di energia per i suoi fabbisogni.
All’organismo sono necessari anche composti inorganici, quindi acqua e sali: questi vengono prelevati
come tali dall’ambiente e direttamente utilizzati. I composti organici ed inorganici prelevati
dall’ambiente sono gli alimenti di cui l’organismo si nutre e che, nel loro insieme, costituiscono
la dieta.
Per essere utilizzata, la miscela di composti diversi variamente strutturati, quindi organici: carboidrati,
lipidi, proteine, acidi nucleici, ed inorganici), che costituisce la dieta, deve anzitutto essere sminuzzata
ed omogeneizzata meccanicamente. D’altra parte essa è costituita in larghissima parte da molecole
complesse, spesso di grossissime dimensioni. Per divenire utilizzabili dall’organismo queste devono
venir scisse, cioè idrolizzate, nei composti più semplici che le costituiscono: i carboidrati , cioè oligo e polisaccaridi,
in monosaccaridi, i lipidi in acidi grassi e glicerolo, le proteine in amminoacidi, ecc. Solo
questi composti relativamente semplici possono essere assorbiti e distribuiti a tutto l’organismo. Il
processo di sminuzzamento e di idrolisi degli alimenti costituisce la digestione; i prodotti della digestione
vanno incontro all’assorbimento.
L’uomo è un organismo onnivoro, in quanto può nutrirsi di alimenti sia di origine vegetale, sia di

alimenti sufficiente a sopperire ai bisogni di materia e di energia dell’organismo, ma anche avere una

di lipidi e di proteine, una volta assorbiti sono in parte ossidati dalle cellule producendo anidride
carbonica e acqua e liberando energia che viene immagazzinata sotto forma di adenosintrifosfato
o ATP, e utilizzata poi per compiere i vari tipi di lavoro. D’altra parte, gli enzimi che fanno parte
del patrimonio dell’organismo umano fanno sì che i monosaccaridi introdotti con la dieta possano
anche essere utilizzati per sintetizzare gli oligo ed i polisaccaridi tipici dell’organismo, gli acidi grassi
possano essere utilizzati per sintetizzare i lipidi propri dell’organismo e gli amminoacidi per sintetizzare
le proteine specifiche dell’organismo. Infine, i monosaccaridi possono essere trasformati in lipidi
o dar origine ad alcuni amminoacidi; gli acidi grassi possono essere utilizzati per sintetizzare alcuni
composti di grande importanza (colesterolo, ormoni sessuali, ecc.), ma non per formare carboidrati;
alcuni amminoacidi possono essere trasformati in monosaccaridi, altri in acidi grassi. Queste

le proteine specifiche dell’organismo. Infine, i monosaccaridi possono essere trasformati in lipidi
o dar origine ad alcuni amminoacidi; gli acidi grassi possono essere utilizzati per sintetizzare alcuni

devono necessariamente essere introdotti come tali con la dieta.
La quantità di alimenti necessaria all’organismo umano varia con l’età e soprattutto con l’entità

Chapter 1

The High Priest swept into the outer chambers of the Pharoah's palace with a distinct air of annoyance. The guards to the inner chamber had already been informed of the impending visit and, remembering the last time that they had tried to stop him, stood aside. He brushed past, barely bothering to acknowledge their existence.

As he entered the inner chamber, the Pharoah finished reading the scroll he had in his hands and looked up.

'Most disappointing, most disappointing...' the Pharoah muttered quietly to himself. 'Your forecasts do nothing to inspire confidence. Perhaps a change of court astrologer might be in order? Anyway, enough of that. What was it you wanted to see me about?'

'Your Brightness,' began the High Priest. The Pharoah cringed at the use of his title. Any attempt at flattery on the astrologer's part was usually a precursor to bad news. 'I have completed the study of all your lands and dominions, as you instructed. My conclusions are disturbing. I have also consulted the heavens and the results I have obtained only go to prove my suspicions. The Empire is failing.'

'Failing?' the Pharoah had a look of astonishment. 'How can it be? Look around. Am I not the wealthiest Pharoah of all time?'

The High Priest took in his surroundings, not failing to notice the vast collection of golden ornaments and priceless treasures that the Pharoah had gathered about him. His next sentence was chosen with great deliberation.

'What you say is true, Mighty One, but it seems that your leadership is the last thing holding our great and enlightened civilization together. It is predicted that, in the very year of your death, our civilization will perish, to be overrun by the hordes of barbarians who mock our learning and sophistication. It will be the world's darkest hour.'

'However, there is a ray of hope. After many lifetimes have passed, and even your memory has faded into obscurity, a new and great civilization will arise from the West, perhaps to become as powerful as our own. Although I cannot foresee the date of your death, I can see how long this uprising will take.'

'Will they worship my Divine Father, Ra, God of the Sun?' asked the Pharoah. He did not think to question the priest's predictions. The priesthood was respected by all men of learning and even the Pharoah took note of their teachings.

'Unfortunately, that information is hidden from me.'

The Pharaoh sat a while in silence, contemplating what he had just been told. The High Priest took great pains to conceal his growing impatience. At length, the Pharoah spoke.

'If they are not Brothers of the Sun, like ourselves, then they are not fit to inherit our world, our empires. We must set them a test. To succeed in this they must act and think like Brothers of the Sun. If they do this then they are worthy inheritors of all the riches I have collected. However,' the Pharoah leant closer to the High Priest and spoke in an altogether more threatening voice, 'if they fail, they must be punished in order to make way for the true Brothers of the Sun who will surely return.'

'An excellent idea, Your Eminence. In fact, I already have an inkling of just how it may be done. Permit me to tell you about it...'
